value.background: Ledger is a French hardware wallet maker founded in Paris in 2014; its devices store private keys offline. A recovery phrase, also called a seed phrase, is the backup that can restore a non-custodial wallet and all its keys on another device, which is why capturing it defeats the purpose of a hardware wallet. Supply-chain attacks target the less-secure links around a product — such as distribution and retail — rather than the manufacturer's own systems.

value.background_zh: Ledger 是一家法国硬件钱包厂商，2014 年成立于巴黎，其设备将私钥离线保存。恢复短语（又称助记词）是可在另一台设备上恢复非托管钱包及其全部私钥的备份，因此一旦被窃取，硬件钱包的防护意义即被抵消。供应链攻击针对的往往是产品周边的薄弱环节——例如分销与零售渠道，而非厂商自身的系统。
value.detailed_summary:
Singapore police said on October 28 that some Ledger hardware wallets bought from retail stores in the country contained malicious components able to capture users' recovery phrases or private keys. At least two cases have been reported since September 10, 2026, with combined losses of about S$3.5 million (roughly US$2.7 million).

The affected devices are sold through ordinary retail channels, so users who believe they hold keys offline may still have had their recovery phrases exposed. Police said the unauthorized parties used the captured data to access wallets and move assets without the owners' knowledge or consent.

Singapore police said they have contacted Ledger, which is reviewing the affected cases, and that investigations are ongoing. The announcement did not specify how many devices were affected or which retailers were involved.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
新加坡警方 10 月 28 日表示，当地部分从零售商店购买的 Ledger 硬件钱包含有恶意组件，可捕获用户的恢复短语或私钥。自 2026 年 9 月 10 日以来，警方已接到至少两起相关案件报告，合计损失约 350 万新元（约合 270 万美元）。

涉事设备通过普通零售渠道售出，这意味着自认为已将私钥离线保存的用户，其恢复短语仍可能已经泄露。警方称，未经授权者利用获取的信息在用户不知情或未同意的情况下访问钱包并转移资产。

新加坡警方称已与 Ledger 建立联系，后者正在审查受影响案件，调查仍在进行中。公告未说明受影响设备的具体数量或涉及哪些零售商。

value.background: MXNB is a Mexican peso-pegged stablecoin issued by Bitso subsidiary Juno, backed 1:1 by peso reserves, and has been pushed across networks including Arbitrum. Western Union has been preparing USDPT for international transactions that bypass SWIFT. value.background_en: MXNB is a Mexican peso-pegged stablecoin issued by Bitso subsidiary Juno, backed 1:1 by peso reserves, and has been pushed across networks including Arbitrum. Western Union has been preparing USDPT for international transactions that bypass SWIFT. value.background_zh: MXNB 是由 Bitso 子公司 Juno 发行的墨西哥比索锚定稳定币，以比索储备 1:1 支撑，并已在 Arbitrum 等网络上推广。Western Union 一直在筹备 USDPT，用于绕开 SWIFT 的国际交易。此次交易正值稳定币基础设施在拉美扩张之际，包括 Circle 在哥伦比亚的 USDC 结算试点，以及其为稳定币支付打造的 Arc 一层区块链。
value.detailed_summary:
Anchorage Digital expanded its custody-and-listing arrangement with Bitso, announced Tuesday, so that Anchorage Digital Bank now custodies MXNB — Bitso's Mexican peso stablecoin — across six blockchains: Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche and Arc. Bitso, in turn, has listed USDPT and USAT, the U.S. dollar stablecoins from Western Union and Tether that Anchorage issues and custodies. Financial terms were not disclosed.

The arrangement places a federally chartered crypto bank beneath both ends of a remittance route that moves tens of billions of dollars a year, with roughly 15% already running through Bitso's infrastructure. Anchorage CEO Nathan McCauley said the corridor is "where stablecoins stop being a thesis and start moving real money at scale."

Bitso's head of stablecoin Ben Reid said clients can now access the full dollar-peso corridor fully onchain, backed by a federally chartered bank. Much of the corridor's volume still moves through correspondent banking, wire transfers and cash-pickup networks.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Anchorage Digital 于周二宣布扩大与 Bitso 的托管与上币安排：Anchorage Digital Bank 现已在 Arbitrum、Base、Ethereum、Polygon、Avalanche 和 Arc 六条区块链上托管 Bitso 的墨西哥比索稳定币 MXNB。Bitso 则相应上线了 USDPT 与 USAT，这两款分别来自 Western Union 和 Tether 的美元稳定币由 Anchorage 发行并托管。双方未披露财务条款。

该安排让一家获得联邦牌照的加密银行同时覆盖这条每年转移数百亿美元汇款通道的两端，而其中约 15% 的资金已通过 Bitso 的基础设施流转。Anchorage 首席执行官 Nathan McCauley 称，这条走廊正是“稳定币不再只是论点、而是开始规模化转移真实资金”的地方。

Bitso 稳定币负责人 Ben Reid 表示，客户现在可以在完全链上的环境中使用完整的美元—比索通道，并由一家联邦牌照银行提供支撑。这条走廊的很大一部分资金目前仍通过代理行、电汇和现金取款网络流转。

Exposure concentrates in MXNB, USDPT and USAT liquidity across the six supported chains rather than in the broader market, so the near-term transmission channel is regional payment flow and custody share rather than system-wide liquidity.

value.background: HBM (high-bandwidth memory) is stacked DRAM placed beside AI processors to feed them data, and SK Hynix is the leading supplier of it. value.detailed_summary:
SK Hynix reported record third-quarter results on Wednesday, with revenue of 104.6 trillion won (up 328% year over year) and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won (up 632%), an 80% operating margin — the first time its quarterly sales topped 100 trillion won and above the 77.5 trillion won operating profit analysts surveyed by Bloomberg had expected. The company said demand for memory will keep outrunning supply through 2030 and that its DRAM and HBM volumes through 2029 are effectively sold out.

The disclosure gives hard earnings data on how long the AI memory shortage is expected to last: SK Hynix says customer volume requirements are more than double what it can supply today, with long-term agreements covering more than half of its 2027 and 2028 capacity. CEO Kwak Noh-Jung attributed confidence in continued AI spending to cloud customers reporting 30% to 80% year-over-year revenue growth and backlogs up two- to five-fold.

Net income was 39.8 trillion won, up 216% year over year but down 58% from the second quarter; CFO Kim Woo-hyun said the gap came from 32.6 trillion won of net non-operating expenses, led by an 11.6 trillion won currency loss and a 22.9 trillion won investment valuation loss. Long-term agreements with 14 key customers including global cloud providers cover more than 50% of 2027-2028 capacity, typically run five years, allow prices to move within an agreed range and include safeguards such as deposits; SK Hynix expects investment to rise significantly in 2027 as the first phase of its Yongin complex enters full-scale operation.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
SK海力士周三公布创纪录的第三季度业绩：营收104.6万亿韩元（同比增长328%），营业利润83.3万亿韩元（增长632%），营业利润率达到80%，这是其单季销售额首次突破100万亿韩元，并高于彭博受访分析师预期的77.5万亿韩元营业利润。公司表示，内存需求将持续超过供给直至2030年，其DRAM与HBM产能到2029年实际上已全部售罄。

value.market_impact_en: The report is a direct read on AI compute economics: SK Hynix is the main HBM supplier, so sold-out capacity through 2029 implies memory costs and GPU supply remain tight, feeding the AI-capex narrative that has driven correlation between AI equities and crypto risk assets, and setting the input-cost backdrop for GPU- and compute-based crypto networks. value.detailed_summary:
Anthropic's public S-1 filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday discloses that its data center buildout is increasingly reliant on natural gas, and states that "competition for access to electrical supply and data center locations with adequate power availability is intense." The filing also sets out plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

The filing makes AI's energy supply and climate exposure an explicit risk factor for public-market investors ahead of a frontier lab's listing, rather than a background concern raised by outside critics.

The quoted language appears as a risk disclosure rather than a committed procurement plan. Coverage of the same filing noted that roughly one-fifth of Anthropic's revenue came from two customers.

value.background: Tokenized stocks are designed as an access layer that complements rather than replaces traditional shares, with Backpack building a two-way conversion between US stocks and tokenized versions on Solana. Backpack has become one of the largest venues for tokenized equity trading on Solana, and its redeemability feature is meant to keep token prices tethered to the assets they track. Kamino is one of several Solana lending protocols, alongside Save (formerly Solend), Marginfi and Port Finance.
value.background_en: Tokenized stocks are designed as an access layer that complements rather than replaces traditional shares, with Backpack building a two-way conversion between US stocks and tokenized versions on Solana. Backpack has become one of the largest venues for tokenized equity trading on Solana, and its redeemability feature is meant to keep token prices tethered to the assets they track. value.background_zh: 代币化股票被设计为传统股票的补充性准入层而非替代品，Backpack 在 Solana 上构建了美国股票与代币化版本之间的双向转换通道。Backpack 已成为 Solana 上代币化股票交易规模最大的场所之一，其可赎回机制旨在让代币价格与所追踪资产保持锚定。Kamino 是 Solana 上多家借贷协议之一，其他还包括 Save（原 Solend）、Marginfi 和 Port Finance。
value.detailed_summary:
Kamino, a lending and liquidity protocol on Solana, has launched USDC loans collateralized by Backpack-issued tokenized stocks, letting borrowers draw dollar liquidity against tokenized equity positions instead of selling them. The product marks a new use of tokenized equities as DeFi loan collateral.

The launch makes tokenized equities usable as collateral inside an onchain credit market, extending real-world asset integration and cross-market composability on Solana. It also puts equity-price and off-market-hours risk directly into a DeFi lending pool.

Backpack issues its tokenized equities through Backpack Securities, with Sunrise handling custody and token issuance, and the tokens can be redeemed for underlying value — a mechanism described as creating a price floor relative to the represented asset. Kamino positions itself as an open-source credit and liquidity protocol on Solana that supports borrowing against onchain collateral through transparent markets.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Solana 上的借贷与流动性协议 Kamino 已推出以 Backpack 发行的代币化股票为抵押品的 USDC 贷款，借款人无需卖出手中的代币化股票即可获得美元流动性。这一产品使代币化股票成为 DeFi 贷款的新型抵押品。

此次上线让代币化股票能够作为链上信贷市场的抵押品，扩展了 Solana 上真实世界资产的整合与跨市场可组合性。同时，股票价格波动与场外时段风险也被直接引入 DeFi 借贷池。

Backpack 通过 Backpack Securities 发行代币化股票，由 Sunrise 负责托管与代币发行，这些代币可按底层价值赎回，这一机制被认为为代币价格相对所代表资产提供了下限支撑。Kamino 定位为 Solana 上的开源信贷与流动性协议，通过透明市场支持以链上资产作抵押的借贷。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through Solana DeFi credit: USDC supply on Kamino now backs loans secured by tokenized equities, so demand for stablecoin liquidity and the pool's collateral composition are directly tied to Backpack's tokenized-stock market depth. The key exposure is liquidation risk when equity markets are closed and tokenized prices thin out, which could affect Kamino's USDC lenders and the tokenized-stock venues whose prices feed the collateral valuations.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导路径落在 Solana DeFi 信贷上：Kamino 上的 USDC 资金如今为以代币化股票作抵押的贷款提供支持，因此稳定币流动性需求与池内抵押品构成直接取决于 Backpack 代币化股票市场的深度。主要风险敞口是股票市场休市、代币化价格流动性稀薄时的清算风险，这可能波及 Kamino 的 USDC 出借方，以及为抵押品估值提供价格的代币化股票交易场所。

value.background: Reth is the Ethereum execution client developed by Paradigm, Foundry is an EVM smart-contract development framework, and Tempo is a payments chain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm. All three are currently built on revm, a widely used Rust EVM implementation that is integrated into Reth, multiple Layer 2 networks and much of the ecosystem's tooling and block-building infrastructure.
value.background_en: Reth is the Ethereum execution client developed by Paradigm, Foundry is an EVM smart-contract development framework, and Tempo is a payments chain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm. All three are currently built on revm, a widely used Rust EVM implementation that is integrated into Reth, multiple Layer 2 networks and much of the ecosystem's tooling and block-building infrastructure.
value.background_zh: Reth 是 Paradigm 开发的以太坊执行客户端，Foundry 是 EVM 智能合约开发框架，Tempo 是 Stripe 与 Paradigm 孵化的支付公链。三者目前均基于 revm 构建，而 revm 是被广泛使用的 Rust EVM 实现，已被集成进 Reth、多个 Layer 2 网络以及生态内大量工具与区块构建基础设施中。
value.detailed_summary:
Paradigm partner and CTO Georgios Konstantopoulos said on X that the team is about to release an audited EVM with built-in just-in-time (JIT) compilation, named evm2, whose code is already public on GitHub. evm2 is a Rust EVM implementation that lets developers customize opcodes, gas rules, transaction types and precompiles without modifying core code, and its README claims execution speeds of up to 2x the current mainstream Rust EVM, revm.

According to Konstantopoulos, evm2 is slated for use in Foundry, Reth, Tempo and other EVM ecosystem projects that adopt Paradigm's tech stack — three components that currently all run on revm.

The audit is described as complete, but the release is framed as upcoming rather than shipped. The 2x speed figure is a claim from the repository's README rather than an independently verified benchmark.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Paradigm 合伙人兼首席技术官 Georgios Konstantopoulos 在 X 上表示，团队即将推出一款已完成审计、内置即时编译（JIT）的新 EVM，名为 evm2，代码已在 GitHub 公开。evm2 是一个用 Rust 编写的 EVM 实现，开发者可在不改动核心代码的情况下自定义操作码、Gas 规则、交易类型和预编译合约；其 README 页面称执行速度最高可达当前主流 Rust EVM 实现 revm 的 2 倍。

据 Konstantopoulos 的说法，evm2 未来将应用于 Foundry、Reth、Tempo 以及所有采用其技术栈的 EVM 生态项目，而这三者目前均基于 revm 构建。

审计被描述为已完成，但发布口径是“即将推出”，而非已经上线。2 倍的速度数字来自仓库 README 的表述，并非经独立验证的基准测试结果。

value.background: Cerebras builds wafer-scale engines — the WSE-3, and the WSE-3T that powers its CS-4 rack-scale system — and sells access to them through AI training and inference cloud APIs. Serving models of trillion-parameter scale typically involves disaggregated prefill and decode workers that exchange KV-cache data over a network, a pattern the Cerebras post discusses for its own hardware.

Serving models of trillion-parameter scale typically involves disaggregated prefill and decode workers that exchange KV-cache data over a network, a pattern the Cerebras post discusses for its own hardware.
value.background_zh: Cerebras 研发晶圆级引擎——包括 WSE-3，以及用于驱动 CS-4 机架级系统的 WSE-3T——并通过 AI 训练云与推理云 API 对外提供算力访问。服务万亿参数级模型通常需要将预填充与解码拆分为不同的工作节点，并通过网络交换 KV 缓存数据，Cerebras 的文章正是围绕其自有硬件讨论这一模式。
value.community_discussion: Sentiment was skeptical but technically engaged. One user said Cerebras is fast in practice but often wrong on the models they can access (GPT OSS 120B, Qwen3 27B) and that OpenRouter offers better models at roughly one-fifth the throughput; others challenged the use of full-precision benchmarks alongside 4-bit serving and the unexplained prefill latency over the interconnect.
value.community_discussion_en: Sentiment was skeptical but technically engaged. value.community_discussion_zh: 讨论整体持怀疑态度，但技术性较强。一位用户表示，Cerebras 在实际使用中速度确实很快，但对其可访问的模型（GPT OSS 120B、Qwen3 27B）来说答案经常出错，而 OpenRouter 提供的模型更好、吞吐约为其五分之一；其他人则质疑文章一边引用全精度基准、一边以 4 比特精度服务模型，以及互连上未加解释的预填充延迟。
value.detailed_summary:
Cerebras published a technical blog post explaining how it deploys and serves trillion-parameter frontier models on its wafer-scale systems, covering the pipeline architecture, an interconnect strategy in which only activations are passed between wafers via RDMA over Ethernet, and continuous request streaming instead of GPU-style batching. The post drew a Hacker News thread with 223 points and 69 comments that questioned its benchmarking and prefill performance claims.

The post is a rare public description of serving frontier-scale models on non-GPU wafer-scale hardware, and Hacker News commenters directly disputed parts of the performance case it makes.

Commenters noted that the post cites full-precision benchmarks while the served models run at 4-bit quantization, and that it does not explain how prefill stays fast over the RDMA interconnect. Others asked whether the "unlike a GPU batch" streaming behavior reflects a GPU hardware limit or the absence of equivalent software scaffolding.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Cerebras published a technical blog post explaining how it deploys and serves trillion-parameter frontier models on its wafer-scale systems, covering the pipeline architecture, an interconnect strategy in which only activations are passed between wafers via RDMA over Ethernet, and continuous request streaming instead of GPU-style batching. The post drew a Hacker News thread with 223 points and 69 comments that questioned its benchmarking and prefill performance claims.

The post is a rare public description of serving frontier-scale models on non-GPU wafer-scale hardware, and Hacker News commenters directly disputed parts of the performance case it makes.

Commenters noted that the post cites full-precision benchmarks while the served models run at 4-bit quantization, and that it does not explain how prefill stays fast over the RDMA interconnect. Others asked whether the "unlike a GPU batch" streaming behavior reflects a GPU hardware limit or the absence of equivalent software scaffolding.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Cerebras 发布技术博客，说明其如何在其晶圆级系统上部署并服务万亿参数前沿模型，内容涵盖流水线架构、晶圆之间仅通过以太网 RDMA 传递激活值的互连策略，以及不同于 GPU 批处理的持续请求流式处理方式。该文章在 Hacker News 引发讨论（223 分、69 条评论），对其基准测试方法与预填充性能的说法提出质疑。

该文罕见地公开描述了如何在非 GPU 的晶圆级硬件上服务前沿规模模型，而 Hacker News 的评论者对其性能论证的部分内容提出了直接质疑。

评论者指出，文章引用了全精度基准测试结果，但实际服务的模型采用的是 4 比特量化；文章也未说明预填充阶段如何在 RDMA 互连上保持高速。还有人追问，所谓“不同于 GPU 批处理”的流式行为究竟是 GPU 的硬件限制，还是缺少相应的软件支撑框架。
value.market_impact_en: The claims sit on the inference-cost side of the AI compute market: if wafer-scale serving delivers the stated throughput, it competes with GPU-based serving stacks for hosted inference of large open-weight models, a segment where per-token pricing is the main competitive lever. The disputed benchmark and prefill points mean the efficiency comparison remains unverified by independent measurement.
value.market_impact_zh: 相关说法落在 AI 算力市场的推理成本环节：若晶圆级服务能达到其所称的吞吐，它将在大型开放权重模型的托管推理上与基于 GPU 的服务栈展开竞争，而该领域的主要竞争杠杆正是每 token 价格。由于基准测试与预填充性能存在争议，这一效率对比尚未经过独立测度验证。

value.background: tBTC is Threshold Network's decentralized wrapped-Bitcoin token: users deposit BTC and receive an ERC-20 representation minted by a node network, which can then be bridged to chains such as Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon and Solana. It competes with custodial wrappers such as WBTC and cbBTC on the strength of its trust model rather than a single custodian. Aave is one of the venues where wrapped bitcoin is posted as collateral for borrowing.
value.background_en: tBTC is Threshold Network's decentralized wrapped-Bitcoin token: users deposit BTC and receive an ERC-20 representation minted by a node network, which can then be bridged to chains such as Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon and Solana. It competes with custodial wrappers such as WBTC and cbBTC on the strength of its trust model rather than a single custodian. Aave is one of the venues where wrapped bitcoin is posted as collateral for borrowing.
value.background_zh: tBTC 是 Threshold Network 推出的去中心化封装比特币：用户存入 BTC 后，由节点网络铸造对应的 ERC-20 代币，随后可跨链至 Arbitrum、Base、Optimism、Polygon 和 Solana 等网络。它以信任模型而非单一托管方为卖点，与 WBTC、cbBTC 等托管型封装资产形成竞争。Aave 是封装比特币被用作借款抵押品的平台之一。
value.detailed_summary:
Threshold paused minting and redemptions of tBTC, its wrapped-Bitcoin asset, and Aave responded by freezing its tBTC reserve as a precautionary measure against bad debt and collateral risk. The halt affects a wrapped-Bitcoin asset that is integrated across multiple DeFi venues, including Aave's lending market.

Aave's action makes the disruption visible on the largest lending venue where tBTC is used, since a reserve freeze is an asset-specific risk action rather than a routine parameter adjustment. Losses from the Threshold halt have not been quantified.

On Aave, a reserve freeze disables new supply and borrow operations for a single market while leaving repayments and withdrawals active, so existing tBTC positions can still be unwound subject to liquidity. Threshold's bridge relies on a decentralized set of node operators using threshold cryptography to mint and redeem tBTC.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Threshold paused minting and redemptions of tBTC, its wrapped-Bitcoin asset, and Aave responded by freezing its tBTC reserve as a precautionary measure against bad debt and collateral risk. The halt affects a wrapped-Bitcoin asset that is integrated across multiple DeFi venues, including Aave's lending market.

Aave's action makes the disruption visible on the largest lending venue where tBTC is used, since a reserve freeze is an asset-specific risk action rather than a routine parameter adjustment. Losses from the Threshold halt have not been quantified.

On Aave, a reserve freeze disables new supply and borrow operations for a single market while leaving repayments and withdrawals active, so existing tBTC positions can still be unwound subject to liquidity. Threshold's bridge relies on a decentralized set of node operators using threshold cryptography to mint and redeem tBTC.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Threshold 暂停了其封装比特币资产 tBTC 的铸造与赎回，Aave 随后冻结了 tBTC 储备，作为防范坏账与抵押品风险的一项预防性措施。此次暂停涉及的封装比特币资产已被多个 DeFi 平台集成，其中包括 Aave 的借贷市场。

Aave 的举措使这一中断在其 tBTC 被使用的主要借贷平台上直接显现，因为冻结储备属于针对单一资产的风险处置，而非例行的参数调整。Threshold 暂停所造成的损失目前尚未量化。

在 Aave 上，冻结储备会关闭单一市场的新增存款与借款操作，但保留还款与提现功能，因此现有 tBTC 头寸在流动性允许的情况下仍可退出。Threshold 的跨链桥依赖一组使用门限密码学的去中心化节点运营商来完成 tBTC 的铸造与赎回。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through collateral and liquidity: tBTC posted on Aave can no longer be newly supplied or borrowed against, and a prolonged mint/redeem halt would leave redemptions of the underlying BTC dependent on the bridge resuming. Related exposure sits in wrapped-Bitcoin markets more broadly, where WBTC, cbBTC and tBTC compete for the same collateral demand and where sentiment reacts to any bridge-level disruption.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于抵押品与流动性：已在 Aave 上的 tBTC 无法新增存入或用于新借款，而若铸造与赎回长期暂停，底层 BTC 的兑付将取决于跨链桥能否恢复。相关敞口更广泛地存在于封装比特币市场——WBTC、cbBTC 与 tBTC 争夺同一块抵押需求，且市场情绪对任何跨链桥层面的中断都较为敏感。

value.detailed_summary:
After deleting its earlier post, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) republished its partnership announcement with Trade[XYZ] with amended wording, stating the two parties "plan to bring Hyperliquid-based perps to the U.S." and that any "U.S. regulated versions" remain strictly "subject to regulatory approvals." The revised post says both parties are seeking approvals to launch a new Hyperliquid-based market for KYC-compliant perpetual futures, including approvals needed to support leveraged trading.

The amended language shows the arrangement has not been approved: no U.S. regulated version of the Hyperliquid-based perpetuals market is confirmed to launch, and leveraged trading would require separate regulatory sign-off.

The original announcement was taken down before being reposted in revised form, and the new text consistently frames the U.S. venue as planned rather than approved. Approval is being sought both for the market itself and specifically for leveraged trading.

value.detailed_summary:
Strive bought 6,182 bitcoin for about $511.4 million between Oct. 17 and Oct. 23 at an average price of roughly $82,732 per coin including fees and expenses, according to SEC filings, lifting its total holdings to 43,000 BTC as of Oct. 23. The purchase moves the company close to the second-largest corporate bitcoin treasury position.

The purchase places Strive just behind the largest corporate bitcoin holders, reinforcing the corporate-treasury channel as a source of spot bitcoin demand. Strive's buying has continued even as Strategy, the largest corporate holder, made no bitcoin purchase in the same week, according to market commentary.

As of Oct. 23, Strive held $504.4 million in cash and cash equivalents, up $186.9 million from Oct. 16, along with 505,000 shares of Strategy's STRC preferred stock valued at about $50.18 million at fair value. Its Class A common shares outstanding rose by about 3.266 million to roughly 118.1 million, while SATS preferred shares stood at 7 million and SATA preferred shares were unchanged at about 14.03 million; Koin Bülteni reported the company opened the door to further purchases.

这笔买入使 Strive 的持仓规模紧追最大的几家企业持币方，进一步强化了企业金库这一现货比特币需求渠道。据市场评论，在最大企业持有方 Strategy 当周未进行比特币购买的情况下，Strive 的买入仍在继续。

value.background: Dual-class share structures split equity into classes with different voting rights, letting select shareholders exert influence disproportionate to their economic ownership. value.detailed_summary:
Coinbase founder Brian Armstrong has gained majority voting control of the company through its share structure even though he owns less than half of its equity, according to Coinpaper.

It means control of Coinbase's corporate decisions is concentrated in its founder despite his minority economic stake.

The control is attributed to Coinbase's share structure rather than additional purchases; dual-class arrangements commonly separate economic ownership from voting rights by assigning different votes per share.

这意味着，尽管阿姆斯特朗的经济持股占少数，Coinbase 的公司决策控制权却集中在其手中。

报道将这一控制权归因于 Coinbase 的股权结构，而非进一步收购；双重股权结构通常通过赋予不同类别股份不同投票权，使经济所有权与投票权分离。

value.detailed_summary:
Anthropic's IPO prospectus, filed on Monday, discloses an expected $1.5 trillion valuation — third-largest in IPO history behind Saudi Aramco's $1.7 trillion and SpaceX's $1.8 trillion — alongside 1,300% six-month revenue growth and a $66.3 billion second-quarter loss. The company says the loss is largely attributable to repriced convertible debt tied to its rising enterprise valuation.

The filing provides unusually detailed financial disclosure from a frontier AI lab ahead of what would be one of the largest listings on record, including revenue retention, compute commitments and accumulated deficit figures that are rarely visible for private AI developers.

Anthropic reports roughly 900% net revenue retention, but its definition includes customers who paid as little as $1 over a year and excludes Pro and Max subscribers. It also expects to spend $265.6 billion on computational services over the next few years and warns in the filing that it does not expect revenue to keep growing at comparable rates; other coverage of the filing has cited first-half net loss figures in the $80 billion range.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Anthropic 于周一提交的 IPO 招股书披露，其预期估值达 1.5 万亿美元，在 IPO 史上位列第三，仅次于沙特阿美的 1.7 万亿美元和 SpaceX 的 1.8 万亿美元；同时披露的还有六个月 1300% 的营收增长和第二季度 663 亿美元的亏损。公司称，该亏损主要来自与估值上升相关的可转换债券重新定价。

这份招股书为外界提供了前沿 AI 实验室少见的详细财务披露，涵盖营收留存率、算力采购承诺和累计亏损等在私营 AI 公司中通常不公开的数据，而此次上市也可能跻身史上规模最大的 IPO 之列。

Anthropic 披露的净营收留存率约为 900%，但其统计口径包含全年仅支付 1 美元的客户，并将 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户排除在外。公司还预计未来几年将在算力服务上支出 2656 亿美元，并在招股书中警告不预期营收会以相近速度持续增长；另有媒体在报道该文件时给出的上半年净亏损数字在 800 亿美元左右。

That valuation channel has historically fed sentiment toward AI-themed crypto tokens, while the convertible-note revaluations tie reported results directly to changes in Anthropic's private valuation marks.

OnePay is a fintech firm majority owned by Walmart that has been expanding beyond payments, including the launch of its own OnePay Wireless phone plans in September 2025. value.background_zh: USDC 是一种设计为锚定美元、可按 1:1 兑换美元的稳定币，其储备为存放于美国受监管金融机构隔离账户中的美元计价资产。OnePay 是一家由沃尔玛多数持股的金融科技公司，正从支付向更多业务扩展，包括于 2025 年 9 月推出自有品牌 OnePay Wireless 手机套餐。Coastal Community Bank 是位于美国华盛顿州西北部的一家社区银行，通过其 CCBX 部门提供银行即服务（BaaS）。
value.detailed_summary:
Walmart-backed fintech app OnePay announced that users can now send USDC stablecoins directly to their OnePay account, with the funds automatically credited to their existing checking-account balance for bill payments and transfers, without going through an exchange conversion.

The feature removes the exchange-conversion step, letting holders of the dollar-pegged stablecoin apply funds directly to bill payments and transfers inside a Walmart-backed consumer app.

OnePay said the related banking services are provided by Coastal Community Bank or Lead Bank.
value.detailed_summary_en:

The feature removes the exchange-conversion step, letting holders of the dollar-pegged stablecoin apply funds directly to bill payments and transfers inside a Walmart-backed consumer app.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
沃尔玛旗下金融科技应用 OnePay 宣布，用户现在可以将 USDC 稳定币直接发送至 OnePay 账户，资金会自动进入其现有的支票账户余额，用于支付账单和转账，无需再经过交易所转换。

该功能省去了交易所兑换环节，使这一锚定美元的稳定币持有者可以直接在沃尔玛支持的消费级应用内将资金用于账单支付和转账。

OnePay 表示，相关银行服务由 Coastal Community Bank 或 Lead Bank 提供。

value.background: MetaMask is an EVM-centric self-custody wallet that defaults to Ethereum, with additional EVM chains added manually and non-EVM chains historically accessed through Snaps or custom configuration. Stellar is an open-source blockchain optimized for fast, low-cost transfers and cross-border payments, connecting to fiat systems through anchors.
value.background_en: MetaMask is an EVM-centric self-custody wallet that defaults to Ethereum, with additional EVM chains added manually and non-EVM chains historically accessed through Snaps or custom configuration. Stellar is an open-source blockchain optimized for fast, low-cost transfers and cross-border payments, connecting to fiat systems through anchors.
value.background_zh: MetaMask 是以太坊虚拟机（EVM）生态为主的自托管钱包，默认网络为以太坊，其他 EVM 链需手动添加，非 EVM 链此前通常通过 Snaps 或自定义配置接入。Stellar 是一条开源区块链，针对快速、低成本转账与跨境支付进行优化，并通过锚点（anchors）连接法币体系。
value.detailed_summary:
MetaMask announced a partnership with the Stellar Development Foundation to make Stellar a default network in both its mobile app and browser-extension wallet, with the integration going live on the day of the announcement. All existing MetaMask accounts will automatically derive Stellar addresses from their existing seed phrases with no extra setup, and existing Stellar users can import their original seed phrases to migrate.

MetaMask Chief Product Officer Gal Eldar framed the integration as part of the wallet's "Open Money" strategy, saying the goal is for the same payment infrastructure to serve all users. The default-network placement removes the manual network-addition step that non-EVM chains have typically required in MetaMask.

Stellar addresses are deterministically derived from users' existing mnemonics rather than requiring a new seed phrase, and the change applies to both mobile and extension clients. The announcement did not disclose on-chain volume targets for the integration.

MetaMask 首席产品官 Gal Eldar 在公告中将此次集成定位为其「Open Money」战略的一部分，称目标是让同一套支付基础设施惠及所有用户。将 Stellar 设为默认网络，省去了此前在 MetaMask 中使用非 EVM 链通常需要手动添加网络的步骤。

Stellar 地址由用户已有助记词确定性派生，而非要求新建助记词，且该变更同时覆盖移动端与插件端。公告未披露此次集成的链上交易量目标。

It does not alter Stellar's supply, consensus, or settlement mechanics.

value.background: A dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) traditionally uses a stock's cash dividends to buy additional shares of the same company; these two funds redirect that cash flow into bitcoin exposure instead. The products follow Franklin Templeton's earlier registration of the two Bitcoin DRIP ETFs for Nasdaq listing.
value.background_en: A dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP) traditionally uses a stock's cash dividends to buy additional shares of the same company; these two funds redirect that cash flow into bitcoin exposure instead. value.background_zh: 股息再投资计划（DRIP）传统上是将股票的现金股息用于增持同一公司的股份；这两只基金则将这部分现金流转向比特币敞口。此前富兰克林邓普顿已为这两只 Bitcoin DRIP ETF 提交注册，以在纳斯达克上市。
value.detailed_summary:
Franklin Templeton announced the Franklin U.S. Equity Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF (FBEQ) and the Franklin U.S. Innovation Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF (FIBT), both to be listed on Nasdaq. Each starts with a 95% equity / 5% bitcoin allocation and systematically reinvests dividends from the underlying stocks into bitcoin, with the index reviewing the bitcoin exposure quarterly to keep it as a secondary allocation.

The products give equity investors a dividend-funded route to bitcoin exposure without buying crypto directly, extending a large asset manager's lineup of crypto-related ETFs.

FBEQ covers roughly 500 of the largest U.S. companies by market capitalization with a 0.09% fee, while FIBT covers 100 large non-financial U.S. companies listed on Nasdaq with a 0.19% fee. The quarterly index review is structured by rule to keep bitcoin a minority weight rather than a variable, discretionary position.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
富兰克林邓普顿宣布推出 Franklin U.S. Equity Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF（FBEQ）与 Franklin U.S. Innovation Bitcoin DRIP Index ETF（FIBT），两只产品均将在纳斯达克上市。二者初始配置均为 95% 股票与 5% 比特币，并将底层股票派发的股息系统性再投资于比特币；相关指数每季度评估比特币敞口，以规则方式将其维持为次要配置。

这两只产品让股票投资者无需直接购买加密货币，就能通过股息资金获得比特币敞口，也扩大了这家大型资产管理公司的加密相关 ETF 产品线。

FBEQ 覆盖约 500 家美国市值最大的公司，费率为 0.09%；FIBT 覆盖 100 家在纳斯达克上市的大型美国非金融企业，费率为 0.19%。季度指数评估通过规则设定，使比特币保持少数权重，而非可自由调整的仓位。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is ETF flows: dividends from equity holdings are converted into bitcoin exposure, so the funds add incremental, rules-based demand tied to equity dividend payouts rather than to investor timing. The 5% starting weight keeps the direct flow small relative to dedicated spot-bitcoin funds, and the quarterly rebalancing rules determine how that exposure drifts over time.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于 ETF 资金流：持仓股票派发的股息被转换为比特币敞口，因此这类产品带来的是与股票派息挂钩、按规则执行的增量需求，而非取决于投资者择时。5% 的初始权重意味着相对于专门的现货比特币基金，其直接资金流规模有限，季度再平衡规则则决定该敞口随时间如何漂移。

value.detailed_summary:
CFTC Chairman Michael Selig told CNBC on Friday that the roughly $6.4 billion Binance hack "proves our exact point" in support of the crypto-market rules the agency proposed earlier this month, pitching a "federal option" that would let offshore venues register with the CFTC and meet the same cybersecurity standards as U.S. markets. Binance, which initially blamed a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop, said its investigation had since uncovered "additional points of breach," with CEO Richard Teng describing a "more complex attack process" that "did not simply use one engineer's permissions."

The remarks hand the CFTC a concrete, record-setting case as it advances its own crypto rulemaking instead of waiting on Congress. Selig argued that on-chain traceability gives regulators leverage even when obfuscation tools are used.

Selig said the exploit did not break Ethereum or its smart contracts but a vulnerability he believed was "introduced from someone's laptop," though the attack partly played out on-chain: the attacker used EIP-7702 to turn a Binance hot wallet into a "sweeper" with 50 pre-signed authorizations. TRM Labs said the broader breach points to a compromise of Binance's signing infrastructure rather than a blockchain weakness; Binance has set aside $6.34 billion to cover losses, the Secret Service and FBI have opened a probe, and TRM Labs and Chainalysis tied the theft to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.

CFTC主席迈克尔·塞利格（Michael Selig）周五对CNBC表示，币安约64亿美元的黑客事件"恰好证明了我们的观点"，为该机构本月早些时候提出的加密市场规则提供依据；他提出一项"联邦选项"，允许离岸交易所在CFTC注册并遵守与美国市场相同的网络安全标准。币安最初将事件归因于一名DevOps工程师的笔记本电脑被入侵，但随后表示调查发现了"更多入侵点"，CEO邓伟政称这是"更复杂的攻击过程"，"并非仅使用一名工程师的权限"。

value.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through market access and custody standards: if offshore venues can register with the CFTC under a federal option, the terms on which U.S. users reach offshore liquidity, and the cybersecurity and signing-infrastructure requirements those venues face, would both change. value.detailed_summary:
Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, which scored 59 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index v5.0, ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and GPT-6 Astra at 57, and 9 points above Google's previous flagship Argon. The release comes roughly half a month after Argon was opened to the public.

The improvement is concentrated in cybersecurity: Carbon can discover software vulnerabilities, verify whether they are exploitable, and generate patches, scoring 88.2%, 54.8% and 71.0% respectively on the three corresponding tests — first place on all three. Google is initially limiting access to a small number of cyber-defense teams rather than releasing it publicly.

Carbon does not lead across the board — it still trails Opus 5.5 in Artificial Analysis's coding agent ranking. Its published promotional API price is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, the same as Argon, and will double once the promotion ends.

Anthropic said it intends to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.

The filing would make Anthropic one of the first frontier AI labs to pursue a public listing, putting its revenue, costs and risk disclosures on the record and creating a reference point other AI companies raising capital can be measured against.

Anthropic's own announcement describes the document as a registration statement relating to a proposed IPO, meaning the offering has not yet been priced or completed. The Decoder episode is an interview with Brookhart analyzing the S-1's numbers rather than a report of new disclosures from the company.

value.detailed_summary:
Ransomware group Whitearmor claims to hold a database of 15,420,003 Gamdom customer accounts and is demanding $15 million in bitcoin to keep it from being published, according to a BlockBeats report on October 27. The group posted Gamdom's information on its leak site and released a roughly 437 KB JSON sample containing about 100 records as evidence, claiming it can access 146 data fields for each account.

If the claim is accurate, the exposure would cover a user base of more than 15 million accounts tied to a crypto gambling platform, according to the group's own assertion. The demand comes as Gamdom says it has not fully recovered from an earlier theft of millions of dollars from its hot wallet.

According to the report, the attackers allegedly gained access through an old internal machine account whose credentials were never rotated, leaving it with administrator privileges despite having been created long ago. The 15.4 million figure and the data sample come from Whitearmor's own claims and have not been independently verified.

value.detailed_summary:
Customers of hardware wallet maker Keystone say a data breach exposed personal information that the company had previously pledged to delete, according to a report by The Block published on Oct. 25, 2026. The accounts describe a leak of customer records rather than of wallet keys or on-device funds.

The exposure creates phishing and physical-security risk for self-custody users, whose contact and delivery information can be used to target them directly, according to the report. It also undercuts a data-retention promise made by a vendor whose product is built around user-controlled security.

The complaint centers on data that customers say Keystone had told them would be erased, and the reported material relates to customer contact and shipping details rather than the air-gapped signing devices themselves.

value.detailed_summary:
Robinhood reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1.424 billion, up 12% year-over-year and roughly in line with the $1.42 billion estimate, while diluted EPS of $0.51 missed the $0.56 estimate. Prediction-market event contract revenue rose more than sixfold to $173 million, while crypto transaction revenue fell 55% to $120 million.

Event contract revenue of $173 million exceeded crypto transaction revenue of $120 million in the quarter, a shift in the company's revenue mix away from spot crypto trading. Robinhood also lowered the upper end of its 2026 adjusted operating expense and stock-based compensation outlook to $2.75 billion from $2.775 billion, keeping the low end at $2.675 billion.

Crypto notional trading volume fell 38% to $50 billion, while event contracts traded rose more than sevenfold to 16.4 billion. Robinhood Chain recorded over $80 billion in DEX trading volume and more than $50 million in network fees in its first quarter on mainnet; net income fell 14% to $476 million and adjusted EBITDA rose 9% to $808 million, with EPS including $0.07 per share of unrealized losses primarily tied to Robinhood Ventures Fund I.

value.background: Akash Network runs a decentralized cloud compute marketplace on a Cosmos SDK chain secured by CometBFT consensus and connected to the IBC ecosystem, with AKT used for governance and staking. value.background_en: Akash Network runs a decentralized cloud compute marketplace on a Cosmos SDK chain secured by CometBFT consensus and connected to the IBC ecosystem, with AKT used for governance and staking. In October 2025 Osuri said Akash intended to abandon its own chain and migrate to a chain that could guarantee its security, with candidate chains possibly inside or outside Cosmos but all IBC-compatible.
value.background_zh: Akash Network 在一条 Cosmos SDK 链上运营去中心化云算力市场，该链采用 CometBFT 共识并接入 IBC 生态，AKT 用于治理与质押。2025 年 10 月，Greg Osuri 曾表示 Akash 将弃用自有链，迁移至能保障其安全的链，候选链可能位于 Cosmos 内部或外部，但均兼容 IBC。
value.detailed_summary:
Akash Network co-founder Greg Osuri said the project's core team has chosen Solana as the destination for migrating Akash Network off its Cosmos sovereign chain akashnet-2, rebuilding the compute marketplace as native Solana programs and turning AKT into a Solana-native SPL token. The move is not final: the team must first pass a governance proposal on akashnet-2 requiring 33.4% quorum and a majority of yes votes, followed by two independent audits before AKT is issued on Solana.

Akash is an established DePIN compute network, so dropping its own sovereign chain would remove the AKT staking and validator structure that currently secures it and place the token inside Solana's liquidity and user base, where rival DePIN projects Helium, Render and io.net already operate. Ethereum L2s were the other shortlisted option in the team's evaluation.

Under the plan, the two-year one-way migration portal opens after the proposal passes and audits complete, converting AKT 1:1 as SPL tokens with unchanged code, decimals and total supply. The compute marketplace cutover date has not been set and requires a separate governance vote after audits and migration drills; existing workloads would run 90 days after that switch before the old chain halts, with staking rewards ending at cutover and validator roles and revenue ending when the old chain stops.

value.detailed_summary_zh:

BNY has published research on tokenization of assets in trade finance, arguing that new legal frameworks and blockchain innovation are bringing tokenized trade finance closer to commercial reality.

value.background_zh: XRP Ledger 是创建于 2012 年的开源、无需许可的区块链，其原生数字资产为 XRP。BNY 曾发布关于贸易融资资产代币化的研究，认为新的法律框架与区块链创新正使代币化贸易融资更接近商业现实。
value.detailed_summary:
Ripple has expanded its strategic partnership with the Bank of New York Mellon (BNY) to broaden institutional digital asset custody capabilities and to explore new institutional use cases for blockchain technology, including tokenized trade finance. The collaboration combines Ripple's digital asset solutions and the public XRP Ledger with BNY's scale, service model and digital capabilities.

The arrangement pairs a major custodian bank with a public blockchain network, extending institutional digital asset custody and moving tokenized trade finance toward commercial testing. BNY's own commentary describes tokenized trade finance as edging closer to commercial reality as legal frameworks and blockchain innovation develop.

Ripple and BNY said they intend to advance tokenized trade finance on the XRPL, subject to client requirements. Tokenized trade finance digitally represents existing trade finance assets such as receivables, which can broaden investor access and simplify how those assets are managed and distributed.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Ripple 扩大与纽约银行（BNY）的战略合作，旨在拓展机构数字资产托管能力，并探索区块链技术在机构领域的新应用场景，包括代币化贸易融资。此次合作将 Ripple 的数字资产解决方案和公共区块链 XRP Ledger 与 BNY 的规模、服务模式和数字化能力相结合。

这一安排将大型托管银行与公共区块链网络结合，扩展了机构数字资产托管范围，并推动代币化贸易融资向商业测试阶段迈进。BNY 自身的分析认为，随着法律框架与区块链创新的推进，代币化贸易融资正逐步接近商业现实。

Ripple 与 BNY 表示，双方计划在 XRP Ledger 上推进代币化贸易融资，具体取决于客户需求。代币化贸易融资将应收账款等既有贸易融资资产以数字形式表示，有望扩大投资者参与范围，并简化相关资产的管理与分销方式。
value.market_impact_en: The announcement ties XRP and the XRPL to a systemically important custodian bank, giving institutional custody and tokenized trade finance a direct channel to XRP Ledger infrastructure. Any eventual shift in institutional flows would depend on client adoption of the announced capabilities rather than the announcement itself.
value.market_impact_zh: 该公告将 XRP 与 XRP Ledger 同具有系统重要性的托管银行联系起来，为机构托管和代币化贸易融资提供了直通 XRP Ledger 基础设施的渠道。机构资金流向是否发生变化，最终取决于客户对这些所公布能力的实际采用，而非公告本身。

UK-based customers lose ongoing access to the platform and must act inside a compressed, request-based window to move their assets. The exit also shows a top-20 exchange withdrawing from a major jurisdiction under regulatory pressure rather than continuing to serve it.

Withdrawal access is request-based rather than automatic, and the window is 48 hours. HTX, formerly known as Huobi, is a Seychelles-based exchange.

value.background: The rating came a day after Ripple won final approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency for Ripple National Trust Bank, which will manage RLUSD's reserves and act as their collateral trustee; RLUSD continues to be issued by Standard Custody under New York Department of Financial Services oversight. RLUSD launched in December 2024 on Ethereum and the XRP Ledger and has a market capitalization of about $2.6 billion, according to CoinGecko, a small share of a stablecoin market worth roughly $300 billion. Ripple has aimed the token at institutions: Standard Chartered began offering institutional custody of RLUSD through its Dubai branch, and in November 2025 Ripple teamed up with Mastercard, WebBank and Gemini to explore using RLUSD on the XRP Ledger to settle fiat transactions on the Gemini Credit Card, pending regulatory approvals.

value.background_zh: 此次评级公布的前一天，Ripple刚刚获得美国货币监理署（OCC）对Ripple National Trust Bank的最终批准，该信托银行将负责管理RLUSD的储备并担任其抵押受托人；RLUSD仍由Standard Custody在纽约州金融服务局（NYDFS）监管下发行。RLUSD于2024年12月在以太坊和XRP Ledger上线，据CoinGecko数据市值约26亿美元，在约3000亿美元规模的稳定币市场中占比仍然很小。Ripple将该代币主要面向机构：渣打银行已通过其迪拜分行提供RLUSD的机构托管服务；2025年11月，Ripple还与万事达卡、WebBank和Gemini合作，探索在XRP Ledger上使用RLUSD结算Gemini信用卡的法币交易，尚待监管批准。
value.detailed_summary:
Moody's Ratings assigned an A2 long-term deposit rating and a P-1 short-term deposit rating to Ripple USD (RLUSD), the dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Ripple subsidiary Standard Custody & Trust Company, the agency said on Tuesday. A2 is the sixth-highest long-term grade on Moody's scale and P-1 is its top short-term grade.

Moody's said the ratings reflect the quality of RLUSD's reserves, which are held mainly in Treasury bills, other short-term U.S. government assets and cash, most of it with custodian BNY. The action gives the stablecoin an independent credit assessment at a time when Ripple is pitching it to institutional users.

Moody's said RLUSD targets 103% coverage of tokens in circulation, and eligible institutional holders can redeem at par within two business days; the agency also flagged that Standard Custody is not a bankruptcy-remote entity and that RLUSD holders do not currently have a direct ownership interest in the reserves. The ratings were requested by the issuer, and Moody's noted that the GENIUS Act, due to take effect in 2027, will exclude required reserves from an issuer's bankruptcy estate.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Moody's Ratings assigned an A2 long-term deposit rating and a P-1 short-term deposit rating to Ripple USD (RLUSD), the dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Ripple subsidiary Standard Custody & Trust Company, the agency said on Tuesday. A2 is the sixth-highest long-term grade on Moody's scale and P-1 is its top short-term grade.

Moody's said the ratings reflect the quality of RLUSD's reserves, which are held mainly in Treasury bills, other short-term U.S. government assets and cash, most of it with custodian BNY. The action gives the stablecoin an independent credit assessment at a time when Ripple is pitching it to institutional users.

Moody's said RLUSD targets 103% coverage of tokens in circulation, and eligible institutional holders can redeem at par within two business days; the agency also flagged that Standard Custody is not a bankruptcy-remote entity and that RLUSD holders do not currently have a direct ownership interest in the reserves. The ratings were requested by the issuer, and Moody's noted that the GENIUS Act, due to take effect in 2027, will exclude required reserves from an issuer's bankruptcy estate.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
穆迪评级（Moody's Ratings）周二宣布，已向Ripple子公司Standard Custody & Trust Company发行的美元稳定币Ripple USD（RLUSD）授予A2长期存款评级和P-1短期存款评级。A2是穆迪长期评级体系中的第六高档，P-1则是其最高档短期评级。

穆迪表示，该评级反映的是RLUSD储备资产的质量——储备主要持有美国国库券、其他短期美国政府资产和现金，其中大部分存放于托管行纽约梅隆银行（BNY）。在Ripple将RLUSD推向机构用户的背景下，这为其提供了一份独立的信用评估。

穆迪称，RLUSD的目标是对流通中的代币实现103%的覆盖，合格机构持有人可在两个工作日内按面值赎回；该机构同时指出，Standard Custody并非破产隔离实体，且RLUSD持有人目前对储备资产不拥有直接所有权权益。此次评级由发行方主动申请，穆迪并提到，将于2027年生效的美国稳定币法律《GENIUS法案》会把法定储备排除在发行人的破产财产之外。
value.market_impact_en: The rating creates a reference point for institutions that screen stablecoin issuers on credit quality, and it reinforces the custody and collateral channels Ripple is building — Standard Chartered's Dubai custody and the proposed collateral-mirroring setup with LMAX Group — through which RLUSD could reach trading desks. RLUSD's roughly $2.6 billion capitalization still leaves it a minor share of the stablecoin market, so the immediate transmission runs through institutional eligibility and reserve-transparency expectations rather than broad liquidity shifts.
value.market_impact_zh: 该评级为那些以信用质量筛选稳定币发行方的机构提供了参照，也强化了Ripple正在搭建的托管与抵押渠道——渣打银行迪拜分行的托管服务，以及与LMAX Group筹划的“抵押镜像”方案——RLUSD可借这些渠道进入交易台。但RLUSD约26亿美元的市值仍只占稳定币市场的一小部分，因此其即时传导路径更多体现在机构的准入标准与储备透明度预期上，而非整体流动性的改变。

value.detailed_summary:
Intel shares fell nearly 30% to $65.76 on Friday, the steepest single-day decline in more than 50 years, wiping out over $146 billion in market value. The drop followed fourth-quarter guidance of $15–16 billion in revenue (midpoint $15.5 billion) and adjusted earnings per share of $0.25, versus analyst estimates of $17.07 billion and $0.43.

Intel said demand for its AI server processors is booming but that manufacturing and packaging shortages are limiting how many chips it can produce, so the AI infrastructure buildout is not translating into near-term revenue. The company also said it expects the PC market to contract through 2027.

Third-quarter results beat guidance: revenue rose 21% year over year to $16.5 billion and adjusted EPS reached $0.52 versus the $0.40 Street estimate, with the Data Center and AI division generating $7.3 billion, up 78%. Intel guided fourth-quarter non-GAAP gross margin down to 38% from 44.1%, and CFO Dave Zinsner cited weaker PC demand, manufacturing constraints on server processors and an accident at a factory in Israel, while warning Intel probably will not generate positive free cash flow next year.

value.background: Customer lists have been a recurring weak point for hardware-wallet makers: Ledger's 2020 leak eventually reached about 292,000 customers, and Trezor and SafePal each disclosed customer-data breaches in August affecting 13,689 and about 39,798 customers respectively. value.detailed_summary:
Keystone said Monday it will destroy 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and has suspended shipping of all unshipped website orders after an attacker obtained the permanent factory WebAuth key its devices use to prove they are genuine. The breach, detected October 20, also exposed 25,964 buyer records from Keystone's Shopify store covering 2024 to 2026, including names, contact details, shipping addresses and order information.

Because the stolen key is what Keystone's own verification page relies on, counterfeit devices could pass the authenticity check and be sold to users who load real savings onto them; Keystone said such devices could be used unknowingly as genuine products, "potentially resulting in asset theft." The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved and that devices delivered before October 20 are unaffected.

Keystone says 51,083 buyer records were involved in total, but 25,119 had already had personal information erased, leaving 25,964 records that still held data — a retention failure the company attributed to automated bulk-deletion tasks that failed without being detected in time against its 180-day erasure policy. Purchases through Amazon and other channels were not affected; website sales will switch to preorders until devices with a new key are produced, and Keystone says it has filed reports with authorities in the EU, UK and other jurisdictions while warning that anyone claiming to run a "recall" and asking users to ship back devices is a scammer.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Keystone 周一表示，将销毁 18,835 台未售出的硬件钱包，并暂停所有官网未发货订单的配送，原因是攻击者获取了其设备用于验证真伪的永久性工厂 WebAuth 密钥。该事件于 10 月 20 日被发现，同时泄露了其 Shopify 商店中 25,964 条 2024 年至 2026 年的买家记录，包括姓名、联系方式、收货地址和订单信息。

由于被盗密钥正是 Keystone 官网验证页面所依赖的凭据，仿冒设备可能通过真伪校验并被卖给用户，而用户可能在其上存入真实资产；Keystone 表示这类设备可能被当作正品 unknowingly 使用，“可能导致资产被盗”。该公司称助记词和私钥未受影响，10 月 20 日之前交付的设备不受影响。

Keystone 称共涉及 51,083 条买家记录，但其中 25,119 条的个人信息已被清除，剩余 25,964 条仍保留数据——公司将这一保留超期归因于自动批量删除任务失败且未被及时发现，违背了其 180 天删除政策。通过亚马逊及其他渠道的购买未受影响；在采用新密钥的设备投产前，官网销售将转为预售，Keystone 表示已向欧盟、英国等司法辖区的有关部门提交报告，并提醒任何以“召回”为名要求用户寄回设备的人都是骗子。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through trust in device provenance rather than liquidity or bitcoin supply: secondary-market and resale Keystone units now carry authentication risk that buyers cannot resolve with the vendor's own check, which may shift demand toward devices bought directly from manufacturers or toward competitors. Keystone says no private keys or recovery phrases were affected and no funds are known stolen, which limits any direct read-through to BTC prices.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于对设备来源的信任，而非流动性或比特币供给：二级市场和转售的 Keystone 设备如今带有买家无法通过厂商自带校验来排除的真伪风险，这可能使需求转向直接从厂商购买或转向其他品牌。Keystone 称私钥和助记词未受影响，目前也不存在已知的资金被盗，因此对比特币价格的直接传导有限。

value.background: The incident, reported on Oct. 29, 2026, is being tracked through public block explorers across ten wallets, eight of which are labeled as exploiters. Stablecoin issuers can blacklist addresses because their tokens are centrally issued, whereas ETH has no issuer able to freeze it, which is why attackers swapped freezable stablecoins into ether. Binance operates the SAFU (Secure Asset Fund for Users) insurance fund, which a community commenter valued at roughly $1 billion in BTC.

value.detailed_summary:
Binance said it is investigating a security incident after wallets linked to the exchange were drained of at least $5.5 billion on Thursday, with on-chain tallies cited by The Block putting suspicious outflows at up to $5.8 billion across Ethereum, Bitcoin and Tron. Binance has not confirmed that user funds were affected, though security researchers widely describe the incident as a hack that would be the largest in the industry's history.

The affected venue is the largest centralized exchange by trading volume, so unresolved questions about the scale of losses and whether customer balances are impaired bear directly on how traders price counterparty and custody risk across the market. Bloomberg reported that the suspected hack triggered emergency asset freezes and sent digital asset prices tumbling.

Tether blacklisted 975.1 million USDT and Circle blacklisted 823 million USDC in the main receiving wallet, and Binance co-CEO Yi He said Ripple also froze about $200 million in RLUSD. The attacker routed funds through Uniswap contracts and borrowed ETH on Aave against USDT collateral — roughly 253,000 ETH (about $570 million) sat in two wallets with no outgoing transfers as of 22:07 UTC — while Aave froze its V3 markets on Ethereum mainnet and Solana-based Kamino paused borrow markets as a precaution.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
币安表示正在调查一起安全事件。此前，与该交易所关联的钱包在周四被转出至少 55 亿美元；The Block 援引的链上统计显示，涉及以太坊、比特币和波场链的可疑外流规模最高达 58 亿美元。币安尚未确认用户资金受到影响，但多名安全研究人员普遍认为这是一起黑客攻击，并可能成为加密行业历史上规模最大的黑客事件。

受影响的是按交易量计算全球最大的中心化交易所，因此损失规模以及客户余额是否受损等尚未解答的问题，会直接影响交易者对全市场交易对手风险和托管风险的定价。彭博报道称，这起疑似黑客事件引发紧急资产冻结，并导致数字资产价格大跌。

Tether 已将主要接收钱包中的 9.751 亿枚 USDT 列入黑名单，Circle 冻结了 8.23 亿枚 USDC；币安联席 CEO 何一表示，Ripple 也冻结了约 2 亿美元的 RLUSD。攻击者通过 Uniswap 合约转移资金，并在 Aave 上以 USDT 为抵押借出 ETH——截至 UTC 22:07，约 25.3 万枚 ETH（约 5.7 亿美元）停留在两个钱包中且无转出记录——同时 Aave 冻结了以太坊主网的 V3 市场，Solana 上的 Kamino 也出于谨慎暂停了借贷市场。
value.market_impact_en: The event transmits directly through exchange-solvency and liquidity channels: BTC, ETH and BNB are the most exposed assets, with bitcoin falling below $79,000, BNB down about 7% and privacy coin Monero up about 6% as some funds rotated toward assets without a freezeable issuer. DeFi lending and DEX venues used as exit routes — Aave and Uniswap on Ethereum, plus Solana protocols such as Kamino — face collateral and market-pause risk, while stablecoin issuers' blacklist actions shift part of the loss back onto centralized control points.

value.background: ZachXBT is a pseudonymous blockchain investigator known for independent on-chain forensic work on crypto fraud, scams and thefts. A multisig wallet requires approval from multiple parties before funds can move, and is commonly used to hold project treasuries and team allocations. OTC trades are negotiated privately between two counterparties and settled off exchange rather than on a public order book.
value.background_en: ZachXBT is a pseudonymous blockchain investigator known for independent on-chain forensic work on crypto fraud, scams and thefts. A multisig wallet requires approval from multiple parties before funds can move, and is commonly used to hold project treasuries and team allocations. OTC trades are negotiated privately between two counterparties and settled off exchange rather than on a public order book.
value.background_zh: ZachXBT 是一位化名区块链调查员，以对加密货币欺诈、骗局和盗窃进行独立链上取证调查而知名。多签钱包需要多方批准才能转移资金，通常用于持有项目财库和团队份额。场外交易（OTC）由交易双方私下协商、在交易所以外完成结算，而非在公开订单簿上撮合。
value.detailed_summary:
On-chain investigator ZachXBT alleged that suspected Axis Robotics insiders received more than 76 million AXIS tokens (valued at over $12 million) from the team multisig wallet before selling them through decentralized exchanges and depositing funds into Bitget. According to ZachXBT, one insider offloaded roughly 42 million tokens (~5.04 million USDC) directly from the team multisig, triggering a 40% price plunge about one week after AXIS listed on Coinbase, Upbit and Binance.

Axis Robotics pushed back, saying 83.5% of team and investor tokens remain locked in a Binance-co-managed vesting contract with no unlocks for 12 months, and that the sold tokens came from the initial circulating ecosystem allocation handed to an OTC counterparty that it says breached lock-up terms. The company said it has paused ties with that counterparty, initiated legal action and pledged to distribute future ecosystem tokens solely through on-chain vesting.

ZachXBT questioned why it took the team two full days to notice roughly 25% of the TGE float being dumped, and why the team neither stopped the sell-off nor issued a public statement before his post. The two accounts differ on the source of the tokens: ZachXBT attributes the sales to the team multisig, while Axis attributes them to an OTC counterparty's breach.
value.detailed_summary_en:
On-chain investigator ZachXBT alleged that suspected Axis Robotics insiders received more than 76 million AXIS tokens (valued at over $12 million) from the team multisig wallet before selling them through decentralized exchanges and depositing funds into Bitget. According to ZachXBT, one insider offloaded roughly 42 million tokens (~5.04 million USDC) directly from the team multisig, triggering a 40% price plunge about one week after AXIS listed on Coinbase, Upbit and Binance.

Axis Robotics pushed back, saying 83.5% of team and investor tokens remain locked in a Binance-co-managed vesting contract with no unlocks for 12 months, and that the sold tokens came from the initial circulating ecosystem allocation handed to an OTC counterparty that it says breached lock-up terms. The company said it has paused ties with that counterparty, initiated legal action and pledged to distribute future ecosystem tokens solely through on-chain vesting.

ZachXBT questioned why it took the team two full days to notice roughly 25% of the TGE float being dumped, and why the team neither stopped the sell-off nor issued a public statement before his post. The two accounts differ on the source of the tokens: ZachXBT attributes the sales to the team multisig, while Axis attributes them to an OTC counterparty's breach.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
链上调查员 ZachXBT 称，Axis Robotics 的疑似内部人士从团队多签钱包获得逾 7600 万枚 AXIS 代币（价值超过 1200 万美元），随后通过去中心化交易所抛售，并将资金存入 Bitget。据 ZachXBT 说法，其中一名内部人士直接从团队多签钱包抛售约 4200 万枚代币（约合 504 万 USDC），导致 AXIS 在登陆 Coinbase、Upbit 和 Binance 约一周后价格暴跌 40%。

Axis Robotics 对此作出回应，称团队和投资者持有的 83.5% 代币仍锁定在由 Binance 共同管理的归属合约中，12 个月内不会解锁，并称被抛售的代币来自初始流通的生态分配额度，已交给一家场外交易对手方，而该对手方违反了锁仓条款。公司表示已暂停与该对手方的关系、启动法律程序，并承诺未来生态代币仅通过链上归属机制发放。

ZachXBT 质疑团队为何花了整整两天才注意到约 25% 的代币生成事件（TGE）流通量被抛售，以及为何在他发帖前团队既未阻止抛售、也未发布公开声明。双方对代币来源说法不一：ZachXBT 将其归因于团队多签钱包，而 Axis 归因于场外交易对手方违约。
value.market_impact_en: The impact is concentrated in AXIS itself: holders on Binance, Coinbase and Upbit were exposed to a reported 40% drawdown days after listing, and the dispute highlights how team and ecosystem allocations can reach the open market through OTC arrangements even when vesting contracts remain locked. It does not appear to be a systemic event for broader crypto markets.
value.market_impact_zh: 影响集中在 AXIS 本身：Binance、Coinbase 和 Upbit 上的持有者在上市数日后即遭遇据称 40% 的回撤，而这一争议也凸显出即便归属合约仍处于锁仓状态，团队与生态分配额度仍可能通过场外交易安排流入公开市场。此事看来并非波及更广泛加密市场的系统性事件。

value.background: Exchange delistings typically unfold in stages: trading is halted first, a withdrawal window follows, and any remaining balances are then handled under the venue's own policy. Kraken has carried out delistings before, including a 2025 plan to remove stablecoins not compliant with the EU's MiCA rules — Tether (USDT), Tether EURt (EURT), PayPal USD (PYUSD) and TrueUSD (TUSD) — with activity in those assets set to stop by March 31.

value.detailed_summary:

Holders of the 13 affected assets have a fixed window ending January 29 to move their tokens off Kraken; after that deadline the exchange's delisting process governs what happens to remaining balances.

value.detailed_summary:
OpenAI has cut the target size of its latest funding round by $10 billion and is now seeking roughly $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, down from an earlier plan of $30 billion at $1.4 trillion, according to the Financial Times. The investor subscription deadline was last Friday, and people familiar said the first close is expected to come in below the $20 billion target because some investors have reduced their commitments.

The downward revision at the world's most closely watched AI lab indicates investors are trimming commitments to AI valuations, as described by the FT, at a time when listed AI-related stocks are being sold off.

OpenAI had justified the earlier valuation of $1.4 trillion — nearly double a prior $852 billion mark — by pointing to rapid revenue growth since July, and had pitched the round as investors' last chance to buy in before a planned IPO next year. The FT report says the first close will fall short of the $20 billion target.

value.background: Keystone confirmed the suspected breach of customer shipping information on X on Saturday, roughly 18 hours after a customer reported a social-engineering call in which Keystone order data was used. The company had previously promised that shipping data is permanently deleted 180 days after an order, and the user who first flagged the potential breach said their device was purchased in 2024. The incident adds to a run of hardware-wallet data and supply-chain problems, including phishing emails sent from Foundation Passport's official domain after compromised Cloudflare API keys, and earlier Ledger-related incidents.

The company had previously promised that shipping data is permanently deleted 180 days after an order, and the user who first flagged the potential breach said their device was purchased in 2024. The incident adds to a run of hardware-wallet data and supply-chain problems, including phishing emails sent from Foundation Passport's official domain after compromised Cloudflare API keys, and earlier Ledger-related incidents.
value.background_zh: Keystone 于周六在 X 上确认了客户收货信息疑似泄露一事，此前约 18 小时，一名用户报告接到使用 Keystone 订单信息的社会工程学电话。该公司此前承诺订单完成后 180 天永久删除收货数据，而最先指出疑似泄露的用户称其设备购于 2024 年。此事叠加了硬件钱包领域近期一系列数据与供应链问题，包括 Foundation Passport 在 Cloudflare API 密钥被入侵后从其官方域名发出的钓鱼邮件，以及此前与 Ledger 相关的事件。
value.detailed_summary:
Keystone said its investigation found that attackers who breached its website obtained the WebAuth device-authentication key used to verify that a hardware wallet is genuine, potentially allowing counterfeit devices to pass official authenticity checks. The company will destroy 18,835 unsold devices built with the old key, pause unshipped orders and move new production to a replacement key, while the incident affected 25,964 purchase records and 12,873 incomplete checkout records.

The compromised key undermines the authenticity check customers rely on to confirm a device is genuine, even though Keystone said seed phrases, private keys and transaction signing were not compromised. The exposed purchase data — names, contact details, shipping addresses and order details — creates phishing risk, and one customer had already reported a social-engineering call that used Keystone order information.

Keystone said the affected records were limited to purchases made through Shopify on its official site, and that its automated data-deletion tool "did not operate reliably," so some personal information was retained beyond the promised period; it also said another roughly 25,000 records had already been permanently erased under its retention policy.
value.detailed_summary_en:

Keystone said the affected records were limited to purchases made through Shopify on its official site, and that its automated data-deletion tool "did not operate reliably," so some personal information was retained beyond the promised period; it also said another roughly 25,000 records had already been permanently erased under its retention policy.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Keystone 表示，调查发现入侵其网站的攻击者获取了用于验证硬件钱包真伪的 WebAuth 设备认证密钥，这可能让仿冒设备通过官方真伪校验。公司将销毁 18,835 台使用旧密钥的未售出设备，暂停未发货订单，并将新生产切换至替换密钥；此次事件涉及 25,964 条购买记录和 12,873 条未完成的结账记录。

密钥泄露削弱了用户用来确认真伪的设备校验环节，尽管 Keystone 表示助记词、私钥和交易签名均未受影响。泄露的购买数据（姓名、联系方式、收货地址和订单详情）带来钓鱼风险，已有用户报告有人利用 Keystone 订单信息实施社会工程学电话诈骗。

Keystone 表示，受影响记录仅限于通过其官网 Shopify 完成的购买，并承认其自动数据删除工具“运行不可靠”，导致部分个人信息在承诺期限之后仍被保留；公司还称另有约 25,000 条记录已按保留政策被永久删除。
value.market_impact_en: The channel here is custody trust rather than liquidity: hardware wallets are the self-custody segment's authenticity layer, and a leaked verification key means users can no longer rely solely on the official check when buying devices second-hand or from resellers. Because seed phrases and private keys were not exposed, the direct fund-loss path is narrower than in a key-extraction breach, but the exposed order data raises phishing risk for existing Keystone owners.
value.market_impact_zh: 这里的传导渠道是托管信任而非流动性：硬件钱包是自托管领域的真伪验证层，验证密钥泄露意味着用户在二手或经销商渠道购买设备时，不能再仅依赖官方校验。由于助记词和私钥未被泄露，直接资金损失的路径比私钥被窃类事件更窄，但订单数据外泄提高了现有 Keystone 用户遭遇钓鱼的风险。

The spending is described as part of a multi-year plan to build a bipartisan bloc of congressional allies so the industry can keep advancing its priorities in Washington after Trump leaves office.

The strategy focuses on candidates judged to have strong odds of winning, with affiliated PACs running advertisements that often do not mention crypto directly. Reuters framed the effort as preparation for a post-Trump policy environment rather than a single-election push.

value.background: ChatGPT's Preview feature turns an HTML code block into a small working webpage, which the product runs inside a restricted frame on a separate web origin. OpenAI has run a bug bounty program since 2023 to reward researchers who report vulnerabilities in its systems.

value.background_zh: ChatGPT 的 Preview 功能会把 HTML 代码块渲染成一个可运行的小网页，并在独立源的受限框架中运行。OpenAI 自 2023 年起运行漏洞赏金计划，奖励向其报告系统漏洞的研究人员。

value.detailed_summary:
Security researchers at Parameter disclosed a ChatGPT account-takeover chain that abused the product's Preview content and layered frontend defenses. OpenAI confirmed that both frontends rejected the reported messages, resolved the issue on October 26 as a P1-severity bug, and awarded a total bounty of $5,000.

A confirmed account-takeover path in ChatGPT means a single clicked share link could run code inside a victim's authenticated session, exposing conversation lists and private content. The chain required user interaction and no in-the-wild exploitation has been reported.

According to the researchers' account, the Preview sandbox itself held — code rendered there could not read the main page — and the bypass instead worked through other layers such as postMessage, CSP and JSONP gadgets. The disclosed chain depended on the victim clicking a public share link.

value.detailed_summary_zh:

ChatGPT 中被确认的账户接管路径意味着，受害者只需点击一个分享链接，攻击代码就可能在其已登录的会话中执行，从而暴露会话列表和私密内容。不过该攻击链需要用户交互，目前也没有在野利用的报告。

根据研究人员的说法，Preview 沙箱本身并未被突破——在其中渲染的代码无法读取主页面——绕过实际发生在 postMessage、CSP 和 JSONP 等其它环节。所披露的攻击链依赖受害者点击公开的分享链接。

value.detailed_summary:
Mistral Large 4, codenamed "Le Chonk", has been published on Hugging Face, and Mistral says the model's weights are now open. According to Mistral's announcement and coverage of it, ML4 is a roughly 1.05-trillion-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model that activates about 52 billion parameters and was trained in Europe.

Mistral describes it as the best open-weight model for coding, which would put a trillion-scale multimodal model directly in developers' hands for self-hosted and fine-tuned deployments. The release also extends Mistral's open-model strategy from its earlier flagship generation to a much larger parameter scale.

The model is positioned as open-weight rather than merely API-accessible, with Mistral's announcement pages dated October 6, 2026. Detailed benchmark results were not included in the material reviewed.

代号“Le Chonk”的 Mistral Large 4 已在 Hugging Face 上线，Mistral 表示该模型权重现已开放。根据 Mistral 的公告及相关报道，ML4 是一个约 1.05 万亿参数的多模态混合专家（MoE）模型，推理时约激活 520 亿参数，并在欧洲完成训练。

Mistral 称其为面向编程任务的最佳开放权重模型，这意味着开发者可以直接获得万亿级多模态模型，用于自托管部署和微调。此次发布也将 Mistral 的开放模型路线从上一代旗舰推进到更大的参数规模。

该模型被定位为开放权重，而非仅通过 API 提供，Mistral 的相关公告页面标注日期为 2026 年 10 月 6 日。所查阅材料中未包含详细的基准测试结果。
value.market_impact_en: An open-weight frontier model of this scale mainly reaches crypto markets through sentiment in AI-linked tokens and decentralized compute or inference networks, whose pitch rests on cheaper, permissionless access to model capacity. Any effect would run through narrative and perceived demand for distributed compute rather than through a direct operational link.
value.market_impact_zh: 这种规模的开放权重前沿模型主要通过情绪渠道传导至加密市场，影响与 AI 相关的代币以及去中心化算力与推理网络——这类项目的叙事基础正是更廉价、无需许可的模型算力获取。其影响更多体现在叙事层面和对分布式算力需求的预期上，而非直接的业务关联。

value.detailed_summary:
Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its next frontier model, claiming "significant gains" in coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity. Google says the model takes the top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0), ahead of Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra.

Google is positioning Carbon as the leader on a widely cited composite benchmark that weighs agents, coding, general capability and scientific reasoning, placing it ahead of the two rival flagship models it names.

According to Google's announcement, Gemini 4 Carbon launches at the same introductory price as Argon — $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens at 95% off the input price. Google says internal teams have seen the model "run for days to persist through dead ends" on complex, multi-step engineering tasks, while some third-party coverage has described earlier reporting on the model as based on internal testing.

谷歌将 Carbon 定位为一项被广泛引用的综合基准上的领先者，该基准按智能体、编程、通用能力和科学推理四类加权评分，谷歌称其领先于所提及的两款竞品旗舰模型。

根据谷歌的公告，Gemini 4 Carbon 的上市价格与 Argon 相同：每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元，缓存输入 token 按输入价格的 95% 折扣计费。谷歌称内部团队已看到该模型在复杂的多步骤工程任务中“连续运行数天、坚持突破死胡同”；同时部分第三方报道称，此前关于该模型的消息基于内部测试。

value.detailed_summary:
Strategy reported $19.5 billion in third-quarter net income and won shareholder approval to move its preferred stocks to daily dividend payments. Per Cointelegraph and Bankless, the change covers four preferred securities — STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD — with daily payouts on STRC starting in November and the other three following in January 2027.

Strategy is the largest corporate holder of Bitcoin, so its capital-structure decisions are closely watched by investors using its securities as a proxy for BTC exposure. Shifting preferred dividends from periodic to daily payments changes the cash-flow profile of those instruments and the company's ongoing payment obligations to preferred holders.

The approval was confirmed on Wednesday, Oct. 28, covering a change the company first floated in September. Daily dividends begin on STRC in November, with STRF, STRK and STRD converted in January 2027.

value.background: Bitcoin Core, the reference implementation used by most full nodes on the network, asks researchers to report vulnerabilities privately to security@bitcoincore.org, where each report is assigned a severity category before being documented in public security advisories. The project has recently adopted a structured public disclosure policy requiring issues to be documented and released after a defined waiting period following a patched release, ending the practice of quietly shipping some fixes.
value.background_en: Bitcoin Core, the reference implementation used by most full nodes on the network, asks researchers to report vulnerabilities privately to security@bitcoincore.org, where each report is assigned a severity category before being documented in public security advisories. The project has recently adopted a structured public disclosure policy requiring issues to be documented and released after a defined waiting period following a patched release, ending the practice of quietly shipping some fixes.
value.background_zh: Bitcoin Core是比特币网络上大多数全节点使用的参考实现，该项目要求研究者通过 security@bitcoincore.org 私下报告漏洞，每份报告会被评定严重等级，随后记录在公开的安全公告中。该项目近期采用了结构化的公开披露政策，要求在补丁版本发布后经过一段既定等待期便公开记录相关问题，从而结束了此前悄然发布部分修复的做法。
value.detailed_summary:
Bitcoin developers moved quickly to patch three security vulnerabilities in the protocol's code after an AI system identified them, CryptoSlate reported. The flaws were uncovered with AI assistance and remediated by developers working on the codebase.

The episode is being framed as a demonstration of both the value and the risks of AI-driven vulnerability research aimed at critical cryptocurrency infrastructure.

这一事件被视为一次双重示范：既体现了AI驱动漏洞研究对关键加密货币基础设施的价值，也暴露了其中的风险。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through node operations rather than trading directly: because Bitcoin Core underpins most full nodes and mining infrastructure, operators face upgrade decisions that touch network resilience, and any doubt about consensus-level code can weigh on sentiment toward the asset. The flaws were patched, and the report did not characterize severity or exploitability as material loss.

value.background: Glamsterdam is Ethereum's next scheduled hard fork after Pectra and Fusaka, with published estimates pointing to mainnet in 2026 and its confirmed headliners being EIP-7732 (enshrined proposer-builder separation) and EIP-7928 (block-level access lists). EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 would raise the cost of creating and accessing state so that fees better reflect resource consumption under a proposed throughput scaling plan — the changes at the centre of the cancelled test.

value.background_zh: Glamsterdam是以太坊在Pectra和Fusaka之后的下一个计划中的硬分叉，公开预测指向2026年上线主网，已确认的核心内容包括EIP-7732（内嵌提议者-构建者分离）和EIP-7928（区块级访问列表）。EIP-8037与EIP-8038则拟提高创建和访问状态的gas成本，使费用更贴近实际资源消耗，属于一项吞吐量扩容计划的组成部分——也正是此次被取消的测试所涉及的核心改动。
value.detailed_summary:
Ethereum's second and final Glamsterdam hard fork testnet on Hoodi was cancelled this week after ChainSecurity found vulnerabilities in the gas-scaling EIPs 8037 and 8038 that could break at least 13 DeFi contracts when a call runs out of gas. Researchers at Eth Labs and the Ethereum Foundation independently spun up AI agents to scan contracts for the flaws, then set up a shared message board in the form of a GitHub repo to coordinate the agents' work.

The cancellation postpones the dress rehearsal for an upgrade that Ethereum DeFi operators depend on, and Eth Labs' Derek Chiang said protocols designers should in future do "much more thorough analysis of potential breakages" much earlier in the process. He added that the agent exercise proved effective enough that a second board has been opened to study EIP-8198, or "Quick Slots", proposed for the follow-up Hegota fork.

Chiang said the vulnerability was found "a few minutes to midnight," causing everyone to scramble, and the Hoodi testnet is not expected to be rescheduled until all of the fork's second-order effects have been properly analyzed. He likened the setup to the OpenAI–Hugging Face hack, where rogue agents coordinated through a message board, noting "the same pattern is useful for the good agents too."

value.detailed_summary_zh:
以太坊Glamsterdam硬分叉的第二个、也是最后一个测试网Hoodi本周被取消，原因是ChainSecurity发现gas扩容类以太坊改进提案EIP-8037与EIP-8038存在漏洞，可能导致至少13个DeFi合约在调用耗尽gas时出错。Eth Labs与以太坊基金会的研究人员各自独立部署了一批AI代理来扫描合约漏洞，随后以GitHub仓库的形式搭建了一个共享“留言板”，用于协调这些代理的工作。

此次取消使得一次关键升级的“彩排”被迫延后，而该升级是以太坊DeFi运营方所依赖的基础设施。Eth Labs的Derek Chiang表示，未来协议设计者应当在流程更早的阶段“对可能引入的破坏做更彻底的分析”。他还表示，AI代理的排查方式成效显著，因此已开设第二个留言板，用于研究拟纳入后续Hegota分叉的EIP-8198（“Quick Slots”）。

Chiang称该漏洞是在“临近午夜的最后几分钟”被发现的，导致所有人紧急应对；在分叉的所有二阶影响被充分推演之前，Hoodi测试网预计不会重新排期。他把这一做法类比于OpenAI与Hugging Face被攻击事件中恶意代理通过留言板协同行动的情形，并表示“同样的模式对‘好代理’同样有用”。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through the upgrade timeline rather than a live exploit: the flaw surfaced during a Hoodi testnet rehearsal, but DeFi contracts that rely on current gas behavior face review before the fork can be rescheduled. A delay to Glamsterdam also defers the expected effects of enshrined proposer-builder separation and block-level access lists on block building and staking economics.
value.market_impact_zh: 影响传导主要经由升级时间表，而非已发生的攻击：漏洞是在Hoodi测试网演练中暴露的，但依赖当前gas行为的DeFi合约需先接受排查，分叉才能重新排期。Glamsterdam的延后也会推迟内嵌提议者-构建者分离与区块级访问列表对区块构建和质押经济模型本应产生的影响。

value.detailed_summary:
S&P Global said on October 26, 2026 that it has completed its acquisition of blockchain security firm OpenZeppelin, a deal first announced on September 17, 2026, with financial terms undisclosed. OpenZeppelin will operate as a standalone business unit led by founder Demian Brener, who reports to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec.

S&P Global said the deal complements its digital asset risk assessment business and is meant to help traditional financial institutions and onchain firms evaluate smart contract and underlying technology risk. The company said it does not expect the transaction to have a material impact on its financial results.

OpenZeppelin, founded in 2015, provides smart contract audits, secure development services and open-source contract libraries; its security team says it has completed more than 900 audits and found over 10,000 vulnerabilities before product launch. S&P Global said OpenZeppelin Contracts will remain open source, free and publicly maintained, and that the cumulative value transferred through the libraries exceeds $38 trillion.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
标普全球于 2026 年 10 月 26 日宣布，已完成对区块链安全公司 OpenZeppelin 的收购。该交易于 2026 年 9 月 17 日首次公布，财务条款未披露。收购完成后，OpenZeppelin 将作为独立业务部门运营，由创始人 Demian Brener 领导，并向标普全球评级总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报。

标普全球表示，此次收购将补充其数字资产风险评估业务，帮助传统金融机构及链上金融企业评估智能合约和底层技术风险。公司还表示，预计该交易不会对其财务业绩产生重大影响。
