value.detailed_summary:
Iron Fish said on Oct. 28 that it is investigating abnormal minting of wIRON, the wrapped version of its token on Base, and has asked cross-chain bridge provider ChainPort to carry out an urgent review. The team told users not to buy wIRON on Base or use the related bridge until further notice because full 1:1 reserve backing can no longer be guaranteed.

By its own statement, Iron Fish can no longer guarantee that wIRON on Base is fully backed 1:1, which puts the redemption value of the wrapped asset in question while the investigation continues.

Iron Fish said it will publish further updates once the facts are confirmed; the cause of the abnormal minting has not been disclosed. The advisory covers both buying wIRON on Base and using the associated bridge.

value.detailed_summary:
Janus Henderson announced it will launch JQQQ, billed as the first licensed tokenized fund tracking the Nasdaq 100, built with Centrifuge's tokenization infrastructure and deployed on the Stellar blockchain, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The fund will initially be open to eligible professional investors outside the United States, with a minimum investment of $100,000.

The launch extends Janus Henderson's onchain products beyond US Treasurys and structured credit into equity-index exposure; the asset manager said its institutional onchain strategies now exceed $1 billion.

JQQQ is structured as a segregated portfolio of a British Virgin Islands investment company and provides indirect exposure to the Nasdaq 100 rather than ownership of the underlying stocks. The fund operates under a licensing agreement with Nasdaq.

value.background_zh: 今年 5 月，DTCC 曾表示计划在 2026 年 7 月试点之后，于 2026 年 10 月全面推出发行与交易代币化证券的服务；2025 年 12 月，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）发出“不采取行动”函，表示不会就其拟议的代币化项目对 DTCC 子公司建议执法行动。Ondo Finance 称其与 Broadridge、DRW、Fireblocks 等一同加入该服务生态，其 7 月推出的 CRCLon 和 SPYon 被称为首批由 DTC 代币化权益支持的代币化股票。CUSIP 是用于便利清算与交收的 9 位证券识别码，传统与链上使用同一代码意味着代币化形式与传统形式仍属同一证券。
value.detailed_summary:
The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation's subsidiary, The Depository Trust Company (DTC), has launched the DTCC Tokenization Service, with 34 securities eligible for tokenization at launch, including selected large-cap Russell 1000 constituents, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries. Tokens are backed 1:1 by securities held in DTC custody, carry the same legal and economic rights as the underlying, use the same CUSIP as the traditional version, and can be transferred peer-to-peer 24/7 between DTC-registered wallets.

DTCC describes the service as creating a "practical path" for tokenized securities adoption, letting DTC participants convert between traditional and tokenized forms while retaining the same ownership rights and investor protections. The partner roster spans custody, wallet and trading infrastructure — BitGo, Blockdaemon, Fireblocks, HashKey, Kaleido, Prometheum, Talos, Temple and Tradeweb — and DTCC said 20 clients have signed agreements to access the service, including Citadel Securities, Citi, Fidelity Investments and JPMorgan.

The service includes built-in compliance controls and near-real-time ownership tracking, and is currently integrated with Canton Network and DTCC's Besu-based private network, with additional networks expected in 2027. Reports of DTC's assets under custody differ — BlockBeats cited roughly $30 trillion while The Defiant cited more than $114 trillion including stocks and ETFs.

DTCC describes the service as creating a "practical path" for tokenized securities adoption, letting DTC participants convert between traditional and tokenized forms while retaining the same ownership rights and investor protections. The partner roster spans custody, wallet and trading infrastructure — BitGo, Blockdaemon, Fireblocks, HashKey, Kaleido, Prometheum, Talos, Temple and Tradeweb — and DTCC said 20 clients have signed agreements to access the service, including Citadel Securities, Citi, Fidelity Investments and JPMorgan.

The service includes built-in compliance controls and near-real-time ownership tracking, and is currently integrated with Canton Network and DTCC's Besu-based private network, with additional networks expected in 2027. Reports of DTC's assets under custody differ — BlockBeats cited roughly $30 trillion while The Defiant cited more than $114 trillion including stocks and ETFs.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
美国存管信托与清算公司（DTCC）旗下子公司美国存托信托公司（DTC）正式上线 DTCC 代币化服务（DTS），首批可代币化证券为 34 只，包括部分罗素 1000 指数大盘成分股、ETF 和美国国债。代币由 DTC 托管的证券 1:1 支持，持有人享有与底层证券相同的法律权利和经济权益，传统市场与链上使用同一 CUSIP 代码，DTC 注册钱包之间可 24/7 点对点转账。

DTCC 称该服务为代币化证券的采用创造了“切实路径”，DTC 参与方可在传统形式与代币化形式之间转换，并保留相同的所有权和投资者保护。合作方覆盖托管、钱包与交易基础设施，包括 BitGo、Blockdaemon、Fireblocks、HashKey、Kaleido、Prometheum、Talos、Temple 和 Tradeweb；DTCC 表示已有 20 家客户签署接入协议，包括 Citadel Securities、花旗、富达投资和摩根大通。

该服务内置合规控制，可近实时追踪所有权，目前接入 Canton Network 和 DTCC 基于 Besu 的私有网络，并计划在 2027 年接入更多区块链网络。关于 DTC 托管资产规模的口径存在差异：BlockBeats 引述约 30 万亿美元，The Defiant 则称包括股票与 ETF 在内超过 114 万亿美元。
value.market_impact_en: The launch gives institutional holders a settlement-utility-sanctioned route to move DTC-custodied securities onto chain, which channels attention toward the approved networks (Canton, Besu), wallet and custody providers named as partners, and the broader tokenized-securities segment that competes for the same institutional allocations. Because tokenized and traditional shares share a CUSIP, the immediate effect is on collateral mobility and settlement workflows rather than on the supply or pricing of existing crypto assets.

value.background: THORChain is a decentralized protocol that enables native cross-chain swaps between layer-1 assets without wrapped tokens or centralized intermediaries, according to its documentation. Ethereum chain reorganizations occur when the network's fork-choice rule selects a competing chain, replacing blocks that had previously been accepted as canonical.

Ethereum chain reorganizations occur when the network's fork-choice rule selects a competing chain, replacing blocks that had previously been accepted as canonical.
value.background_zh: 根据其官方文档，THORChain 是一个去中心化协议，可在不使用包装代币、也不依赖中心化中介的情况下，实现一层原生资产之间的跨链兑换。以太坊链重组是指网络的共识分叉选择规则选中了竞争链，从而取代此前已被视为规范的区块。
value.detailed_summary:
THORChain's cross-chain swap functionality remains suspended across 12 supported chains following a reported error in its refund mechanism. According to Chainalysis, an Ethereum chain reorganization on the morning of October 31 (EDT) caused THORChain to mistakenly issue a double refund to a user who had deposited 10 ETH, prompting an emergency pause.

The pause blocks cross-chain swaps for all users across most of THORChain's bridges. Chainalysis said the halt also inadvertently delayed the laundering of a significant amount of funds stolen from Binance.

Chainalysis attributed the trigger specifically to an Ethereum chain reorganization, a event in which previously accepted blocks are replaced by a competing chain. No loss figures for the incident have been confirmed in the supplied material.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
在报告出现退款机制错误后，THORChain 的跨链兑换功能在 12 条支持的链上仍处于暂停状态。据 Chainalysis 称，10 月 31 日上午（美国东部时间）以太坊发生的一次链重组，导致 THORChain 错误地向一名存入 10 ETH 的用户进行了双重退款，从而触发了紧急暂停。

此次暂停使所有用户在 THORChain 的大部分桥上无法进行跨链兑换。Chainalysis 表示，这一暂停也意外延缓了一笔从 Binance 窃取的大额资金的洗钱活动。

Chainalysis 将触发原因具体归结为以太坊链重组，即此前已被接受的区块被竞争链上的区块所取代的事件。在现有材料中，尚未确认该事件造成的损失金额。
value.market_impact_en: The halt directly affects THORChain's cross-chain swap venue and its native RUNE token, whose utility is tied to securing and governing that liquidity network. With multi-chain swap access suspended, users seeking native cross-chain trades must route through other venues or wait for the protocol to resume, though the materiality depends on how long the pause lasts.
value.market_impact_zh: 此次暂停直接影响 THORChain 的跨链兑换场所及其原生代币 RUNE，后者的用途与保障和治理该流动性网络紧密相关。在多链兑换通道暂停期间，寻求原生跨链交易的用户只能转向其他场所或等待协议恢复，其实际影响程度取决于暂停持续的时间。

value.detailed_summary:
Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for tokenized US stocks and ETFs issued by EQX Labs, covering S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers (EQSPY, EQQQQ) plus single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX. The tokens are already registered on Hyperliquid mainnet, but matching will not open until 21:30 Beijing time on October 26 (9:30 a.m. ET the same day).

The listing adds a tokenized-equity asset class to one of the largest on-chain derivatives venues, extending on-chain trading in major US stocks and index trackers beyond conventional market hours. Trading has not yet begun, so liquidity and any regulatory response remain untested.

EQX says each token is backed 1:1 by real shares but is legally structured as a limited-recourse debt note issued by a segregated portfolio company in the British Virgin Islands rather than direct share ownership, and is not offered to US persons.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for tokenized US stocks and ETFs issued by EQX Labs, covering S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers (EQSPY, EQQQQ) plus single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX. The tokens are already registered on Hyperliquid mainnet, but matching will not open until 21:30 Beijing time on October 26 (9:30 a.m. ET the same day).

The listing adds a tokenized-equity asset class to one of the largest on-chain derivatives venues, extending on-chain trading in major US stocks and index trackers beyond conventional market hours. Trading has not yet begun, so liquidity and any regulatory response remain untested.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Hyperliquid 将上线由 EQX Labs 发行的代币化美股与 ETF，首批共 11 个以 USDC 计价的 HIP-1 现货市场，标的包括追踪标普 500 与纳斯达克 100 的 EQSPY、EQQQQ，以及对应英伟达、特斯拉、苹果、微软、亚马逊、Alphabet、Meta、美光与 SpaceX 的单一标的。相关代币已在 Hyperliquid 主网注册上线，但撮合交易要到北京时间 10 月 26 日 21:30（美东时间同日 9:30）才正式开启。

此次上线使这一大型链上衍生品交易平台新增代币化股票资产类别，让主要美股与指数追踪标的在传统交易时段之外也能在链上交易。不过交易尚未开始，流动性和监管反应均未经过检验。

EQX 称每个代币由真实股份 1:1 支持，但法律结构为英属维尔京群岛隔离组合公司发行的有限追索权债务凭证，而非直接持有股票，且不对美国人士开放。
value.market_impact_en: The move channels spot demand for US equity and index exposure into Hyperliquid's USDC-settled order books, tying the venue's spot liquidity and HYPE-denominated activity to tokenized-equity flows that can run around the clock. The BVI debt-note structure and exclusion of US persons mean the exposure sits with offshore and non-US participants, leaving the product's regulatory footing a variable for the broader tokenized-equity segment.
value.market_impact_zh: 这一举措把对美股与指数敞口的现货需求引入 Hyperliquid 以 USDC 结算的订单簿，使该平台的现货流动性与以 HYPE 计价的活动同可全天候运行的代币化股票资金流挂钩。BVI 债务凭证结构与排除美国人士意味着敞口主要落在离岸及非美国参与者身上，产品监管基础仍是整个代币化股票赛道的一个变量。

value.background: A Lightning invoice is a signed payment request generated by the recipient that commits to a payment hash, with the recipient releasing the corresponding preimage once paid. BOLT11 is the long-standing invoice format, and implementations depend on consistent parsing of its fields to determine whether a payment has settled.
value.background_en: A Lightning invoice is a signed payment request generated by the recipient that commits to a payment hash, with the recipient releasing the corresponding preimage once paid. BOLT11 is the long-standing invoice format, and implementations depend on consistent parsing of its fields to determine whether a payment has settled.
value.background_zh: 闪电网络发票是由收款方生成并签名的支付请求，其中承诺一个支付哈希，收款方在收到付款后公开对应的原像（preimage）。BOLT11 是长期使用的发票格式，各实现依赖对其字段的一致解析来判断一笔支付是否已完成。
value.detailed_summary:
Lightning developers tightened BOLT11, the Lightning Network's invoice standard, on Oct. 19, requiring software to reject invoices with ambiguous, missing or repeated payment-hash and payment-secret fields. The change follows a developer's account of an attack that made completed Bitcoin withdrawals appear unpaid.

Invoices with ambiguous payment-hash or payment-secret fields could let a completed payment be presented as unpaid, so requiring implementations to reject them removes that ambiguity at the protocol-standard level.

The change was merged into BOLT11, the invoice specification that Lightning wallets and nodes use to encode payment requests including the destination, amount, payment hash and expiry. The reported incident was described in a developer's account and has not been confirmed as a large-scale exploit.
value.detailed_summary_en:

The change follows a developer's account of an attack that made completed Bitcoin withdrawals appear unpaid.

Invoices with ambiguous payment-hash or payment-secret fields could let a completed payment be presented as unpaid, so requiring implementations to reject them removes that ambiguity at the protocol-standard level.

The change was merged into BOLT11, the invoice specification that Lightning wallets and nodes use to encode payment requests including the destination, amount, payment hash and expiry. The reported incident was described in a developer's account and has not been confirmed as a large-scale exploit.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
闪电网络开发者于10月19日收紧了其发票标准 BOLT11，要求软件拒绝包含含糊、缺失或重复的支付哈希（payment hash）与支付密钥（payment secret）字段的发票。此举源于一名开发者披露的一起攻击事件：该攻击使已完成的比特币提现显示为未支付。

支付哈希或支付密钥字段存在歧义的发票，可能让已完成的支付被呈现为未支付；要求各实现拒绝此类发票，便在协议标准层面消除了这一歧义。

该修改已被合并进 BOLT11——闪电网络钱包和节点用来编码支付请求（包含目标节点、金额、支付哈希和有效期）的发票规范。相关事件源自一名开发者的描述，尚未被确认为大规模漏洞利用。

The rule change constrains implementation behavior rather than token supply or liquidity.

value.background: Polymarket is a prediction-market platform where users trade on the outcomes of future events. In June, the company reported that hackers drained more than $2.9 million in user funds by compromising a third-party vendor; it said that vulnerability was fixed, the vendor has been removed from its website and affected users would be fully reimbursed, with wallets losing under $10,000 receiving automatic refunds by October 30 and larger losses requiring a signed release form. Frontend compromises — in which wallet-draining code is injected into a site or its third-party scripts — have also hit other DeFi venues, including Balancer and Aerodrome.

value.detailed_summary:
Multiple Polymarket users reported unauthorized transfers out of their accounts, with some claiming losses of hundreds of thousands of dollars, prompting the platform to enter cancel-only mode, pause relayer actions and temporarily halt trading. Polymarket said one of its third-party providers had been compromised, that the issue affecting Polymarket.com had been identified and fixed, and that the matter has been referred to law enforcement.

The incident triggered a platform-wide trading restriction on one of the largest prediction-market venues, and Polymarket said anyone affected "will be made whole." The root cause remains unconfirmed, with users suspecting a frontend compromise.

Cancel-only mode allowed traders to cancel existing orders but not place new ones, and relayer actions — the service that submits users' signed transactions to the blockchain — were paused; the Predictions Trading API was listed as experiencing a major outage, with Polymarket reporting all systems operational as of 7:05 pm UTC. Security firm Hudson Rock said a DebugBear-hosted script containing wallet-draining code hard-codes the same fallback recipient address as a wallet flagged as the suspected attacker's, which Arkham data showed holding about $2.65 million in POL after multiple USDC.e-to-POL swaps through Relay.

value.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through Polymarket's Polygon-based rails: USDC.e deposits and POL holdings in user wallets, plus the relayer channel that submits signed transactions, are the directly affected segments, and the halt froze order placement across its prediction markets. The suspected frontend/third-party vendor vector extends supply-chain risk to other DeFi venues that rely on externally hosted scripts and relayers.

value.background_zh: HIP-3（即“构建者部署永续合约”）是 Hyperliquid 的一项升级，于 2025 年 10 月 13 日在主网上线，允许独立运营者在 Hyperliquid 基础设施上无需许可地创建自己的永续合约市场。永续合约是没有到期日、跟踪标的资产价格的衍生品合约，据 DefiLlama 数据，Hyperliquid 是此类合约全球最大的去中心化交易所。据报道，美国总统特朗普曾在 8 月 19 日表示，CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 正在推动以“完全合规且合法的方式”将 Hyperliquid 引入美国。被列为 trade[XYZ] 投资人的亿万富翁投资者 Stanley Druckenmiller 表示“很高兴成为 trade(xyz) 的投资者”，ICE 也进行了战略投资。
value.detailed_summary:
Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the operator of the New York Stock Exchange, and trade[XYZ] announced on Thursday a plan to use Hyperliquid as the infrastructure layer for perpetual futures markets serving US traders across crypto, equities, commodities, foreign exchange and other real-world assets, subject to regulatory approvals. Under the structure, Hyperliquid supplies the underlying technology via HIP-3, trade[XYZ] designs and implements the markets, and ICE operates the regulated market and clearing structure.

The arrangement would give US retail traders a regulated route to Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures, while handing ICE a new entry point into retail trading; ICE said the vehicle would run separately from its institutional futures business. OKX CEO Star said the project is being advanced jointly by ICE, trade[XYZ] and OKX, with retail distribution to flow through an ICE-OKX joint venture.

ICE said it has signed a definitive agreement with Trade.xyz and will be the exclusive US operator, with a dedicated clearing structure intended to shield its existing customers — more than 99% of its market participation is institutional — from retail counterparty risk. Existing trade[XYZ] HIP-3 markets will remain unchanged, and HIP-3 deployers remain independent operators responsible for their own deployments.

value.detailed_summary:
On the Alphabet Q3 2026 earnings call, CEO Sundar Pichai said the Gemini app has reached 1 billion monthly active users, making it Google's fastest-growing product, and that first-party model APIs now process nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, up 40% quarter-over-quarter and more than 4x year-over-year. The company also formally announced its new frontier model Gemini 4 Carbon alongside progress on the Genie 4 world model, while guiding 2027 capex to "increase significantly."

Quarterly revenue of $127.6 billion (+25%) and profit both came in slightly below Wall Street expectations, and the stock fell about 9% to 10% in after-hours trading as investors weighed record cloud growth against heavy spending and negative free cash flow.

Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7 billion on enterprise demand for AI infrastructure, AI solutions and TPU systems, while Google Services grew 11% to $96.3 billion. The company kept its 2026 capex guidance at $195 billion to $205 billion without specifying a 2027 figure, and free cash flow was negative for a second consecutive quarter, which the CFO partly attributed to higher TPU inventory and a $5.2 billion EU fine payment.

On the Alphabet Q3 2026 earnings call, CEO Sundar Pichai said the Gemini app has reached 1 billion monthly active users, making it Google's fastest-growing product, and that first-party model APIs now process nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, up 40% quarter-over-quarter and more than 4x year-over-year. The company also formally announced its new frontier model Gemini 4 Carbon alongside progress on the Genie 4 world model, while guiding 2027 capex to "increase significantly."

Quarterly revenue of $127.6 billion (+25%) and profit both came in slightly below Wall Street expectations, and the stock fell about 9% to 10% in after-hours trading as investors weighed record cloud growth against heavy spending and negative free cash flow.

Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7 billion on enterprise demand for AI infrastructure, AI solutions and TPU systems, while Google Services grew 11% to $96.3 billion. The company kept its 2026 capex guidance at $195 billion to $205 billion without specifying a 2027 figure, and free cash flow was negative for a second consecutive quarter, which the CFO partly attributed to higher TPU inventory and a $5.2 billion EU fine payment.

The report traces $37 million in stolen funds from U.S. victims through a Bahamas-based bank and into Tether’s USDT.

value.background: ENSv2's architecture was previously detailed on the ENS blog, which described hierarchical registries in which each name can provide its own registry implementation for managing subnames, giving name owners direct control over ownership and transfer rules. value.background_zh: ENS 此前在其博客中详细介绍过 ENSv2 的架构，其中提到分层注册表：每个域名都可以提供自己的注册表实现来管理子域名，让域名所有者直接掌控所有权与转移规则。ENS 是以太坊上的命名系统，负责把人类可读的 .eth 域名映射到钱包地址及其他资源，ENS 代币为其治理资产。
value.detailed_summary:
ENSv2 went live on the Ethereum mainnet on October 27, introducing hierarchical registries and a more granular permission model under which a single name can act as an independent on-chain registry, letting communities and organizations define their own subdomain issuance rules and delegate management by zone. The release also updates how names are resolved, adds support for shared record links, and ships a new ENS App for general users plus an ENS Explorer for developers.

ENS says its ecosystem now covers more than 36 million domains across over 600 applications, and that existing .eth domains will continue to work without re-registration, with users able to voluntarily upgrade to ENSv2 in the ENS App starting today. The permission changes shift control over subdomain rules and ownership management from a single global registry to individual name owners.

After upgrading all eligible domains, users can claim a commemorative ENSv2 NFT designed by artist Polyhop, one per wallet, subject to Ethereum network gas fees. 1inch, MetaMask, Safe, Uniswap, PayPal, Venmo and OpenSea are among the applications already adapting to ENSv2.

value.detailed_summary:
Datavault AI disclosed that roughly 1,328.43 BTC — about $150 million — tied to an equity transaction cannot be withdrawn from a third-party Biconomy wallet. The company said in an 8-K filed October 26 that it requested a withdrawal to an external account in June 2026, and the transfer was still incomplete as of October 26, with the specific reason undisclosed; its stock closed down 49.6% at about $0.067 on October 27.

Datavault AI concluded the funds no longer meet the conditions for recognition as digital assets and should instead be recorded as a subscription receivable from an equity issuance, shown as a deduction from shareholders' equity. The company plans to restate affected financial statements and is reassessing its going-concern status, with the timing of the restatement not yet determined.

Per the filing, Scilex agreed in September 2025 to purchase Datavault AI shares and pre-funded warrants for about 1,328.43 BTC, with the bitcoin credited to its Biconomy wallet via an off-chain transfer. The root cause of the blocked withdrawal has not been disclosed.

value.detailed_summary_zh:

Datavault AI 认定，相关款项不再符合数字资产的确认条件，应改记为股权发行应收认购款，并作为股东权益的减项列示。公司计划重述受影响的财报，同时重新评估持续经营能力，重述时间尚未确定。

根据该文件，Scilex 于 2025 年 9 月同意以约 1,328.43 枚 BTC 购买 Datavault AI 股票及预付认股权证，相关比特币通过链下划转记入其在 Biconomy 的钱包。提现受阻的根本原因未予披露。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is custody and disclosure risk rather than bitcoin spot supply: a listed issuer's inability to move BTC held in a third-party wallet, combined with a planned restatement, raises questions about how corporate bitcoin holdings are verified and reported. The effect is concentrated in a single small-cap issuer's equity rather than in BTC pricing or liquidity.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是托管与信息披露风险，而非比特币现货供给：一家上市公司无法动用存放于第三方钱包的 BTC，叠加计划重述财报，使市场对企业持有比特币的核验与列报方式产生疑问。影响集中于该小市值公司的股票本身，而非 BTC 的价格或流动性。

value.background_zh: 超大规模云服务商（如亚马逊 AWS、谷歌云等大型云厂商）已向 Anthropic 投入数十亿美元，帮助这家人工智能初创公司满足算力需求。博通提供半导体与基础设施软件，并在定制 AI 芯片业务上持续扩张，因而成为大规模 AI 算力建设中的相关参与方。
value.detailed_summary:
Anthropic has secured a total of $77 billion in additional financing from Google, Amazon and Broadcom, according to a BlockBeats report dated October 26. Each agreement carries its own conditions: Amazon's tranche is tied to Anthropic reaching specific compute-capacity milestones, while Google's $20 billion commitment is partly contingent on Anthropic meeting certain revenue targets.

The commitments tie Anthropic's funding directly to compute buildout and revenue performance, linking capital to measurable operational milestones rather than a single lump-sum investment. Google and Amazon have now collectively invested tens of billions of dollars in Anthropic and are its largest shareholders.

Of the total, Google's portion is a $20 billion commitment that is partly conditional on revenue targets; Amazon's agreement is structured around compute-capacity milestones. The report characterizes Google and Amazon as simultaneously investors in and competitors of Anthropic.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
据 BlockBeats 10 月 26 日消息，Anthropic 已从谷歌、亚马逊和博通处获得总计 770 亿美元的额外融资。每项协议均附带各自条件：亚马逊的融资与 Anthropic 达到特定算力里程碑挂钩，谷歌的 200 亿美元承诺则部分取决于 Anthropic 能否实现特定营收目标。

这些承诺将 Anthropic 的资金与算力建设和营收表现直接绑定，使资本投放与可衡量的运营里程碑挂钩，而非一次性投入。谷歌和亚马逊累计向 Anthropic 投资数百亿美元，已成为其最大股东。

在总额中，谷歌的部分为 200 亿美元承诺，部分取决于营收目标；亚马逊的协议则围绕算力容量里程碑设定。报道称，谷歌和亚马逊既是 Anthropic 的投资方，同时也是其竞争对手。
value.market_impact_en: The deal signals continued hyperscaler willingness to commit large, milestone-linked capital to frontier AI labs, a sentiment channel that typically feeds narratives around AI- and decentralized-compute-related crypto tokens. It also underscores how much AI compute demand is being routed through a small set of cloud and chip suppliers, a concentration that shapes the infrastructure backdrop AI-adjacent crypto projects benchmark against.
value.market_impact_zh: 该交易显示超大规模云厂商仍愿向前沿 AI 实验室投入与里程碑挂钩的大额资金，这一情绪渠道通常会传导至 AI 概念及去中心化算力相关加密代币的叙事。同时它也凸显 AI 算力需求高度集中于少数云厂商与芯片供应商，这种集中度构成了 AI 相关加密项目对标的底层基础设施环境。

value.background: Private credit funds lend directly to companies, typically outside public bond markets, and are often financed in part by bank credit lines. A May 2025 Federal Reserve FEDS Note found committed credit lines from the largest U.S. banks to private credit vehicles had grown about 145% over five years to roughly $95 billion as of 2024-Q4. Deloitte has described bank exposure to private credit as a "financing loop" that can create hidden concentrations, and Moody's Analytics warned in June 2025 that private credit could be a conduit for contagion in a downturn.

value.background_zh: 私人信贷基金通常绕开公开债券市场，直接向企业放贷，其资金来源中常包含银行授信额度。美联储2025年5月发布的一份FEDS Note显示，美国大型银行对私人信贷工具的承诺授信额度在过去五年增长约145%，截至2024年第四季度约为950亿美元。德勤将银行对私人信贷的敞口形容为一种可能造成隐性集中度的“融资循环”，穆迪分析则在2025年6月警告称，私人信贷可能成为经济下行期风险蔓延的通道。
value.detailed_summary:
CryptoSlate reported that banks are owed roughly $349 billion by private credit funds, which may not be collecting cash from their borrowers. The report frames the exposure as a source of credit risk rather than a confirmed loss event.

The report says the exposure raises concerns about credit risk and broader market contagion, given how bank financing and private credit lending are interlinked.

The claim is presented as a reported exposure figure, not as a confirmed default or realized loss. The concern centers on whether borrowers are paying cash, rather than accruing obligations.

value.background: RLUSD is Ripple's U.S. dollar-pegged stablecoin, which like other issuer-controlled stablecoins can be frozen at the token level. value.background_en: RLUSD is Ripple's U.S. dollar-pegged stablecoin, which like other issuer-controlled stablecoins can be frozen at the token level. value.background_zh: RLUSD 是 Ripple 发行的美元锚定稳定币，与其他由发行方控制的稳定币一样，可在代币层面被冻结。Kamino 是构建于 Solana 的开源信贷与流动性协议，用户可进行借贷并以加密资产作抵押。在加密行业，发行方冻结疑似被盗资金已成为攻击事件后的常见处置方式。
value.detailed_summary:
According to Decrypt, Binance co-CEO Yi He said Ripple has frozen approximately $200 million of RLUSD. Suspected attackers are using Uniswap and Aave to swap freezable stablecoins into ETH, and Kamino has paused borrowing in its SOL/BTC markets.

The freeze shows an issuer using its blacklist capability at scale against suspected exploit proceeds, while the attackers' move into ETH via DEXes and lending markets illustrates how freezable stablecoins are being converted into assets issuers cannot freeze. Kamino's halt shows the response extending into Solana lending markets.

The figure comes from Binance co-CEO Yi He as cited by Decrypt, and full loss attribution remains emerging. Kamino's pause applies to borrowing in its SOL/BTC markets.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
据 Decrypt 报道，币安联席 CEO 何一表示 Ripple 已冻结约 2 亿美元 RLUSD。疑似黑客正通过 Uniswap 和 Aave 将可被冻结的稳定币兑换为 ETH，Kamino 已暂停其 SOL/BTC 市场的借贷。

此次冻结显示发行方大规模动用黑名单能力处置疑似被盗资金；而攻击者经由去中心化交易所和借贷协议换成 ETH，说明可冻结稳定币正被转换为发行方无法冻结的资产。Kamino 暂停借贷则表明应对措施已外溢至 Solana 借贷市场。

该金额来自币安联席 CEO 何一的说法，并由 Decrypt 引述，完整损失归因仍在形成中。Kamino 的暂停措施针对其 SOL/BTC 市场的借贷。

value.detailed_summary:
TechCrunch reported on October 27 that large-scale conversions of convertible notes have revealed the full extent of Amazon's ownership stake in Anthropic, putting the cloud giant in line to earn far more from the AI lab's planned IPO than venture investors. Amazon structured much of its investment as convertible notes — debt that converts into shares upon an IPO or sale — rather than taking stock up front.

The disclosures indicate that a corporate backer, not traditional venture firms, holds the largest single financial upside in one of the sector's most anticipated listings. Venture investors including Menlo Ventures, Sequoia, Sound Ventures and Spark Capital are still expected to see billions in returns, according to the report.

Amazon has invested billions in Anthropic beyond its initial commitment, a $4 billion investment the company said it had completed. The report attributes the unusually large gap between corporate and venture returns to Anthropic's sheer size, since lead venture investors in a typical tech IPO hold double-digit percentage stakes.

value.background: CoinDCX suffered a roughly $44 million hack in July 2025 that it blamed on a server breach, prompting a bounty hunt for the stolen funds and later the arrest of an employee. value.background_zh: CoinDCX 在 2025 年 7 月遭遇约 4400 万美元的黑客攻击，公司将其归咎于服务器被入侵，随后悬赏追回被盗资金，并有一名员工被捕。该交易所今年还面临欺诈与冒充诈骗的指控并引发警方调查；在 2025 年黑客事件后，其创始人否认了与 Coinbase 的收购谈判报道。CoinDCX 表示随着调查推进将披露更多细节。
value.detailed_summary:
CoinDCX said in a blog post that 15.99 million USDT (about $16 million) was drained on the Tron network on Oct. 21, after an internal process failed to sweep customer deposits out of wallets the exchange retired following its 2025 hack. The Mumbai-based exchange said it absorbed the loss itself and that customer funds remain safe, reversing CEO Sumit Gupta's earlier public claim that reports of a breach were a "false alarm."

The admission brings CoinDCX's losses from two incidents to nearly $60 million, following the roughly $44 million hack in July 2025. It also publicly reverses the CEO's denial, turning a disputed on-chain flag into a company-confirmed loss.

The retired wallets at the center of the loss were a legacy of the earlier breach and kept receiving residual deposits, which the failed automated transfer system left exposed. On-chain investigator ZachXBT disputed Gupta's account, noting the wallet in question had still been sweeping user deposits into CoinDCX's current hot wallet as recently as April and May, and urged customers to withdraw their assets.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
CoinDCX 在一篇博客文章中表示，10 月 21 日有 1599 万枚 USDT（约合 1600 万美元）在波场（Tron）网络上被转走，原因是内部流程未能将客户存款从其 2025 年黑客事件后停用的钱包中归集转出。这家总部位于孟买的交易所称已自行承担该损失、客户资金安全，这与其 CEO Sumit Gupta 此前公开称相关入侵报道是“虚惊一场”的说法相反。

value.background: SAFU (Secure Asset Fund for Users) is a Binance emergency insurance fund created to protect user assets in extreme situations such as hacks. Exchange insurance funds of this kind are typically maintained to cover losses from hacks, theft or operational failures.

value.background_zh: SAFU（用户安全资产基金）是币安设立的一只应急保险基金，用于在黑客攻击等极端情况下保护用户资产。币安表示，该基金充当最后一道安全网：若安全事件导致用户资金损失，交易所可动用SAFU资产对受影响用户进行赔付。此类交易所保险基金通常用于覆盖黑客攻击、盗币或运营故障造成的损失。
value.detailed_summary:
Binance intends to draw down approximately half of its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) to cover losses stemming from a breach, according to a TOKENPOST report. If carried out, it would be one of the largest deployments of an exchange insurance reserve to date.

SAFU is Binance's last-resort user compensation pool, so a draw of this size signals that the incident's losses are large relative to the reserve the exchange maintains for exactly this purpose.

SAFU was set up in July 2018 and is funded by allocating a percentage of Binance's trading fees; Binance Academy describes the fund as holding crypto assets valued at roughly US$1 billion as of 2026, a figure that fluctuates with the market.

value.background: Redeemable debt carries a fixed maturity date on which the issuer must repay the principal to holders. GPU-backed lending and project-level debt for AI data centers have grown into a distinct financing channel as AI compute build-outs scale, with lenders focusing on hardware commitments, delivery timing and counterparty credit quality. An investment-grade rating generally broadens access to such credit by signaling a relatively lower assessed default risk.

value.background_zh: 可赎回债务设有固定到期日，发行方须在该日期向持有人偿还本金。随着 AI 算力建设规模扩大，以 GPU 为抵押的贷款以及面向 AI 数据中心的项目级债务已发展为独立的融资渠道，贷款方关注硬件采购承诺、交付时点和交易对手的信用质量。投资级评级通常意味着被评估的违约风险相对较低，从而拓宽此类信贷的可获得性。
value.detailed_summary:
Elon Musk said SpaceX has completed $40 billion of redeemable GPU debt financing, with the proceeds mainly earmarked for GPUs scheduled to arrive in the first and second quarters. According to BlockBeats, Musk credited the company's investment-grade credit rating and revenue from its Starlink satellite-internet and launch businesses with keeping its access to credit open.

As described, the package would be among the largest disclosed debt raises aimed specifically at buying AI compute, indicating that GPU purchases are being funded through credit markets rather than only from operating cash flow. Musk said the spending will have little impact on the current quarter because the hardware has not yet arrived.

Musk described the instrument as redeemable debt — borrowing with a defined repayment date — but the flash report did not disclose lenders, coupon, maturity or other terms, and there was no independent confirmation of the financing. BlockBeats listed the borrower under the ticker SPCX.O, although SpaceX is not a publicly listed company.

value.background: Private keys are the secret credentials that authorize control over crypto assets, making their management a critical security layer for exchanges and custody providers. value.background_zh: 私钥是授权控制加密资产的秘密凭证，因此私钥管理是交易所和托管机构的关键安全层。根据搜索摘要，Coinbase 此次事件的核心是一家分析服务供应商，而非交易所核心系统被攻破。加密公司此前也面临类似的供应链风险：据 Hacklido 报道，Bitget 曾表示攻击者利用了一款第三方安全产品的漏洞。
value.detailed_summary:
DailyCoin published an analysis arguing that a third-party vendor incident at Coinbase exposes the security weaknesses contractors can introduce to exchange private-key and customer infrastructure. Search excerpts describe the vendor as analytics provider Amplitude, which experienced a security incident affecting a small subset of Coinbase customer contact data, while Coinbase said it found no evidence of unauthorized access to its systems.

The episode highlights how third-party vendors can become an indirect exposure path for exchange customer data, even when the exchange says its own systems were not breached.

The described exposure involved customer contact data rather than private keys, and Coinbase said funds were unaffected. No loss figure or confirmed private-key compromise has been disclosed.

DailyCoin 发布分析文章称，Coinbase 的一起第三方供应商事件暴露了承包商可能给交易所私钥和客户基础设施带来的安全薄弱环节。搜索摘要显示，该供应商为分析服务商 Amplitude，其安全事件影响了少部分 Coinbase 客户联系方式数据，而 Coinbase 表示未发现其系统遭到未经授权访问的证据。

该事件凸显出，即使交易所表示自身系统未被攻破，第三方供应商仍可能成为交易所客户数据间接泄露的通道。

value.detailed_summary:
Utah prosecutors filed criminal charges against prediction-market operator Kalshi and two of its co-founders, with the company and each executive facing 13 felony counts and one misdemeanor for violating the state's gambling laws, according to Ars Technica and the Associated Press. The case is tied to a $10 sports-related event contract, escalating a legal conflict over Kalshi's sports offerings.

The charges mark a new front in the dispute over who can regulate event contracts: Kalshi operates under CFTC oversight federally, while Utah enforces its own strict anti-gambling statutes. Ars Technica reported that Utah had already defeated Kalshi in federal court after the company filed a preemptive suit seeking to block enforcement of state gambling law.

The charges were filed on a Wednesday, months after a federal judge rejected Kalshi's effort to bar Utah from enforcing its gambling laws, per the AP. Ars Technica reported that the Trump administration has separately sued Utah over the state's total ban on gambling in an effort to protect Kalshi.

value.detailed_summary:
The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed suit in the US District Court for the District of Utah against the State of Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown, seeking to block state enforcement against prediction-market operators. The Monday filing came a week after Utah announced legal action against Kalshi and its affiliates to recover up to $60 million in profits it alleges were obtained illegally.

The suit directly contests whether a state may apply its gambling laws to platforms the CFTC has authorized, and a Kalshi spokesperson, Jacki McGavick, said no single state should have a veto over a national derivatives market overseen by the CFTC. The CFTC argues that Utah's action intrudes on what it calls Congress's exclusive federal scheme for commodity derivatives.

The CFTC's complaint states that the event contracts targeted by Utah are "swaps" under the Commodity Exchange Act and that the exchanges offering them are CFTC-regulated Designated Contract Markets. It argues Utah's efforts to stop a CFTC-regulated DCM from offering CFTC-approved products bypass congressional intent to federally preempt state law.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）向美国犹他州联邦地区法院提起诉讼，起诉犹他州及该州总检察长德里克·布朗（Derek Brown），试图阻止该州对预测市场运营方展开执法。该诉讼于周一提交，而一周前犹他州刚宣布对Kalshi及其关联公司采取法律行动，要求追回其声称非法获得的至多6000万美元利润。

这起诉讼直接争讼各州能否对CFTC已批准的平台上适用本州博彩法。Kalshi发言人杰基·麦加维克（Jacki McGavick）表示，不应由任何单一州对受CFTC监管的全国性衍生品市场拥有否决权。CFTC则主张，犹他州的行动侵犯了国会为商品衍生品市场设计的专属联邦监管体系。

CFTC在诉状中称，犹他州所针对的事件合约属于《商品交易法》下的“互换”（swaps），提供这些合约的交易所是受CFTC监管的指定合约市场（DCM）。该机构主张，犹他州试图阻止受CFTC监管的指定合约市场提供经CFTC批准的产品，绕过了国会以联邦法优先于州法的立法意图。
value.market_impact_en: The outcome shapes where CFTC-registered event-contract venues such as Kalshi can operate, since state gambling enforcement or preemption determines platform access in individual states by market. A federal win would remove a state-level legal channel for restricting those venues; a state win would open the door to profit-recovery claims and operating restrictions.
value.market_impact_zh: 该案结果将决定Kalshi等CFTC注册事件合约平台可在哪些地区运营，因为州层面的博彩执法或联邦优先适用直接决定各州的市场准入。若联邦一方胜诉，各州限制此类平台的法律途径将被削弱；若州一方胜诉，则可能引发追缴利润的索赔和运营限制。

value.background: OKXICE TSV is a 50-50 joint venture between NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and OKX's U.S. holding company, planning 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on OKX's XLayer blockchain paired with stablecoins such as USDC. Its original Oct. 4 notice proposed 63 tokenized stocks from 62 companies, and several later objectors, including Wells Fargo and Arm, were not on that initial roster. The SEC issued the innovation exemption on Sept. 17, 2026, requiring a venue to notify a company at least 30 days before offering a third-party tokenized version of its shares, with a written objection within that window barring the listing. Nasdaq, which won SEC approval for its own tokenized securities pilot, has said it will opt its shares out of the exemption.

value.background_zh: OKXICE TSV是纽约证券交易所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）与OKX美国控股公司按50比50组建的合资企业，计划通过OKX的XLayer区块链上经许可的Uniswap v4资金池，实现美国股票代币化的7×24小时交易，并以USDC等稳定币作为交易对。其10月4日的初始公告提出上线来自62家公司的63只代币化股票，而包括富国银行和Arm在内的部分后来的反对者并不在最初名单中。SEC于2026年9月17日发布创新豁免，要求交易场所在上线第三方代币化股票版本前至少30天通知相关公司，若公司在期限内书面反对，则该股票不得上线。已获得SEC代币化证券试点批准的纳斯达克表示，将把自家股票排除在该豁免之外。
value.detailed_summary:
JPMorgan Chase, Coca-Cola, Dell Technologies, AMD, Adobe, Applied Materials and Sandisk were added to OKXICE TSV's list of objecting issuers in a notice dated Tuesday (Oct. 27), bringing the total to 33 from 26 a day earlier. Under the SEC's innovation exemption, a timely written objection bars the venue from listing a third-party tokenized version of a company's stock.

Each timely objection legally removes those shares from the venue's listable universe, so the rapid escalation from nine objectors on Oct. 15 to 33 directly narrows a high-profile tokenized-equity product. JPMorgan is the third major bank to object, after Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo.

The list stood at 16 on Oct. 19 and 22 on Oct. 23; earlier objectors include Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, Intel and Oracle, while Nvidia, Tesla, Apple and Amazon have not objected so far. The notices have not disclosed the companies' reasons, and an objection applies only to that venue.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
根据OKXICE TSV（代币化证券交易场所）周二（10月27日）发布的公告，摩根大通、可口可乐、戴尔科技、AMD、Adobe、应用材料和闪迪被新增至反对发行人名单，使总数从一天前的26家升至33家。根据美国证交会（SEC）的创新豁免，若公司在规定期限内以书面形式提出反对，该场所即不得上线由第三方发行的该公司股票代币化版本。

每一次及时提出的反对都会在法律上把这些股票从该场所的可上线范围中剔除，因此反对者从10月15日的9家迅速增至33家，直接压缩了这一备受关注的代币化股票产品的可交易标的。摩根大通是继高盛和富国银行之后第三家提出反对的大型银行。

该名单在10月19日为16家、10月23日为22家；此前的反对者包括微软、Alphabet、高盛、富国银行、英特尔和甲骨文，而英伟达、特斯拉、苹果和亚马逊迄今尚未提出反对。公告未披露这些公司的反对理由，且反对仅对提出反对的该场所有效。
value.market_impact_en: The objections shrink the supply of equities that OKXICE TSV can actually list, putting a visible ceiling on one of the largest tokenized-equity venues before launch and testing whether the SEC exemption can scale when issuers opt out. The signal extends to the broader tokenized-equity and RWA segment, where issuer consent — rather than venue technology — is emerging as the binding constraint on which stocks can trade onchain.
value.market_impact_zh: 这些反对压缩了OKXICE TSV实际可上线的股票供给，在尚未启动前就为这一规模最大的代币化股票场所之一设下可见上限，也检验了在发行人选择退出时SEC豁免能否规模化。该信号还波及更广泛的代币化股票与RWA（现实世界资产）板块——决定哪些股票能够上链交易的约束正在从场所技术转向发行人同意。

value.background: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI lab known for openly released models. A coding agent's “harness” is the surrounding runtime — sessions, tool calls, sandboxing, permissions — that turns a model into an agent that can act on a repository. Autonomous code contributions remain contentious: search results reference an AI coding agent's pull request to the Python library Matplotlib that a maintainer rejected, citing contribution guidelines.

value.background_zh: DeepSeek 是一家以开放发布模型著称的中国 AI 实验室。编码智能体的“Harness”指的是模型之外的那层运行时——会话、工具调用、沙箱、权限等——正是它让模型变成能在代码仓库中执行操作的 Agent。智能体自主贡献代码仍存争议：搜索结果提到，一个 AI 编码智能体向 Python 库 Matplotlib 提交的 PR 被维护者以贡献规范为由拒绝。
value.detailed_summary:
DeepSeek has open-sourced its Agent base architecture, according to QbitAI, which framed the release around AI agents that can autonomously locate bugs and submit pull requests. Search descriptions identify the released component as DeepSeek Harness, an open-source agent runtime rather than a new model.

An open-source agent runtime from a major model lab gives developers a self-hostable base for building coding agents instead of assembling that scaffolding themselves or depending on a vendor's hosted product.

Descriptions of the harness say it is built on Cordis's “everything is a plugin” architecture and provides sessions, tools, workspaces, sandboxing, plugins, agent loops, plus web and terminal interfaces; experimental items listed include agent teams, auto approval review and scheduled tasks. The QbitAI item itself carries little technical detail beyond the autonomous bug-finding and PR-submission claim.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
据量子位报道，DeepSeek 将其 Agent 底座架构开源，报道以“AI 已经自己找到 Bug 并提交 PR”作为核心看点。搜索结果显示，此次开源的对象是 DeepSeek Harness，即一套开源的 Agent 运行时，而不是新的模型。

头部模型厂商开源 Agent 运行时，意味着开发者可以直接在可自托管的底座上构建编码智能体，而不必自行拼装这套脚手架，也不必依赖厂商的托管产品。

对这套 Harness 的介绍称，它基于 Cordis 的“一切皆插件”架构，提供会话、工具、工作区、沙箱、插件、Agent 循环以及网页与终端界面；被标注为实验性的功能包括 Agent 团队、自动审批审核和定时任务。量子位的报道本身除“自主找 Bug 并提交 PR”之外，技术细节较少。

value.background: Jepsen, founded by Kyle Kingsbury, is a distributed-systems safety research group that maintains an open-source testing library and publishes in-depth analyses of databases, queues and consensus systems, checking whether systems live up to their documentation's claims. ParticleDB describes itself as a multi-model database for AI agents, letting users run agents, workflows and their own code beside the data. TLA+ is Leslie Lamport's formal specification language for modeling and verifying concurrent and distributed systems.
value.background_en: Jepsen, founded by Kyle Kingsbury, is a distributed-systems safety research group that maintains an open-source testing library and publishes in-depth analyses of databases, queues and consensus systems, checking whether systems live up to their documentation's claims. ParticleDB describes itself as a multi-model database for AI agents, letting users run agents, workflows and their own code beside the data. TLA+ is Leslie Lamport's formal specification language for modeling and verifying concurrent and distributed systems.
value.background_zh: Jepsen 由 Kyle Kingsbury 创立，是一家分布式系统安全性研究机构，维护开源测试库并发布针对数据库、队列和共识系统的深度分析，检验这些系统是否达到了其文档中的宣称。ParticleDB 自称是面向 AI 智能体的多模型数据库，允许用户在数据旁运行智能体、工作流和自己的代码。TLA+ 是 Leslie Lamport 提出的形式化规范语言，用于对并发系统和分布式系统进行建模与验证。

Several focused on the unsubstantiated TLA+ claim, and one drew a distinction between software that is "correct by construction" — where failures are local bugs — and software that is "incorrect by construction" and only works through luck and workarounds.

value.detailed_summary:
Jepsen published an analysis of ParticleDB, a multi-model database marketed for AI workloads, testing versions 1.1.4 through 1.1.18.11.rc-22 and finding that its "Full ACID" claims did not hold. The report documents loss of committed writes, internal consistency violations, G1a (aborted read), G1b (intermediate read) and P4 (lost update) anomalies, and states that Jepsen filed 96 issues against the system.

Jepsen explicitly recommended that users halt further deployment of ParticleDB and migrate to other databases as soon as possible, and suggested checking or rebuilding database state from more reliable sources where possible.

Jepsen said ParticleDB's home page advertised the system as "formally proven" with a TLA+ proof, but that no TLA+ specification was available during the collaboration, leaving it unclear which properties were proven or whether they described ParticleDB as built. The report also lists failures of the claimed Postgres compatibility, including partially invisible rows that could not be deleted, dropped tables re-emerging in distorted forms, confused columns and strings turning into integers.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Jepsen published an analysis of ParticleDB, a multi-model database marketed for AI workloads, testing versions 1.1.4 through 1.1.18.11.rc-22 and finding that its "Full ACID" claims did not hold. The report documents loss of committed writes, internal consistency violations, G1a (aborted read), G1b (intermediate read) and P4 (lost update) anomalies, and states that Jepsen filed 96 issues against the system.

Jepsen explicitly recommended that users halt further deployment of ParticleDB and migrate to other databases as soon as possible, and suggested checking or rebuilding database state from more reliable sources where possible.

Jepsen said ParticleDB's home page advertised the system as "formally proven" with a TLA+ proof, but that no TLA+ specification was available during the collaboration, leaving it unclear which properties were proven or whether they described ParticleDB as built. The report also lists failures of the claimed Postgres compatibility, including partially invisible rows that could not be deleted, dropped tables re-emerging in distorted forms, confused columns and strings turning into integers.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Jepsen 发布了对 ParticleDB 的分析报告。ParticleDB 是一款面向 AI 工作负载的多模型数据库，Jepsen 测试了 1.1.4 至 1.1.18.11.rc-22 的多个版本，认定其“完整 ACID”的宣称并不成立。报告记录了已提交写入丢失、内部一致性违规，以及 G1a（读到已中止事务）、G1b（读到中间状态）和 P4（更新丢失）等异常，并称共向该项目提交了 96 个问题。

Jepsen 明确建议用户停止继续部署 ParticleDB，并尽快迁移到其他数据库；同时建议在可能的情况下，从更可靠的数据源核对或重建数据库状态。

Jepsen 表示，ParticleDB 官网曾宣称该系统已通过 TLA+ 获得“形式化证明”，但在双方合作期间并未提供任何 TLA+ 规范，因此无法确定究竟证明了哪些性质，也无法确定这些性质描述的是否是实际构建出的 ParticleDB。报告还列举了其宣称的 Postgres 兼容性失效的具体表现，包括部分不可见且无法删除的行、被删除的表以扭曲形态重新出现、列错乱以及字符串变成整数等。

value.detailed_summary:
Chainalysis has confirmed a security breach in which customer details were exposed, CryptoRank reported. The disclosure makes the blockchain-analytics and compliance vendor the latest third-party provider in the crypto industry to acknowledge a compromise of client information.

Chainalysis supplies transaction-tracing and compliance tooling to exchanges, financial institutions and government agencies, so exposure of its customer details raises data-protection and counterparty-risk questions for those clients.

The report describes the impact as confined to customer details rather than any loss of funds, with the confirmed scope of exposed data described as limited.

value.background: In crypto derivatives, liquidation is the automatic closure of a leveraged position when the trader's margin is no longer sufficient to support the trade. Long liquidations hit traders betting on rising prices when prices fall. Sharp declines can trigger cascading forced selling as more leveraged positions are closed.
value.background_en: In crypto derivatives, liquidation is the automatic closure of a leveraged position when the trader's margin is no longer sufficient to support the trade. Long liquidations hit traders betting on rising prices when prices fall. Sharp declines can trigger cascading forced selling as more leveraged positions are closed.
value.background_zh: 在加密衍生品中，清算是指当交易者的保证金不足以维持交易时，杠杆仓位被自动平仓。当价格下跌时，押注价格上涨的多头交易者会遭遇多头清算。急剧下跌可能引发连锁强制卖出，因为更多杠杆仓位被平仓。
value.detailed_summary:
Bitcoin traded below $80,000 as long liquidations reached $1.34 billion, according to The Defiant, reflecting a sharp market-wide deleveraging across crypto derivatives.

The event marks a material market-wide deleveraging in crypto derivatives, with leveraged long positions forced out as bitcoin fell below the $80,000 level.

The $1.34 billion figure refers to long positions, meaning traders betting on higher prices were liquidated during the drop.
value.detailed_summary_en:

value.detailed_summary_zh:
据 The Defiant 报道，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，多头清算规模达到 13.4 亿美元，反映出加密衍生品市场出现急剧的全市场去杠杆。

这一事件标志着加密衍生品市场出现实质性的全市场去杠杆，随着比特币跌破 80,000 美元，杠杆多头仓位被迫平仓。

13.4 亿美元指的是多头仓位，即在下跌过程中，押注价格上涨的交易者被清算。
value.market_impact_en: The liquidation cascade is concentrated in bitcoin derivatives, particularly perpetual futures and margin positions, where forced closures can amplify spot and derivatives liquidity pressures and weigh on near-term sentiment. Bitcoin's role as the market's primary collateral and benchmark asset can also transmit the deleveraging effect to the broader crypto market.
value.market_impact_zh: 清算连锁反应集中在比特币衍生品，尤其是永续合约和保证金仓位，强制平仓可能放大现货和衍生品的流动性压力，并对短期市场情绪构成压力。比特币作为市场主要抵押品和基准资产的角色，也可能将去杠杆效应传导至更广泛的加密市场。

value.background: Investors had positioned for the opposite outcome since Bolsonaro unexpectedly finished first in the Oct. 4 first round with 47.03% of valid votes to Lula’s 45.16%; the Ibovespa rose 7.85% the next day and EWZ gained more than 10% on bets that Bolsonaro would tighten public finances and open the way to lower interest rates. Monday’s drop erased that rally and at its lows left the Ibovespa about 11% below its Oct. 2 close. Polymarket is a crypto-based prediction market and Kalshi a regulated event-contract exchange, where a contract paying $1 on a win trades near 80 cents when traders imply an 80% probability. Bolsonaro objected to Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin’s decision to extend voting until 7 p.m. at Lula’s campaign’s request, though his own campaign had separately sought extra voting time in parts of three states.

value.detailed_summary:
Brazil’s equity market lost more than $200 billion in value at Monday’s open after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in Sunday’s runoff, 51.79% to 48.21%. The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) fell as much as 26% from Friday’s close of about $42.60 to $31.40, the dollar rose as much as 12% against the real, and São Paulo exchange B3 halted trading for 30 minutes — its first circuit breaker since the COVID-19 pandemic.

The result contradicted prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi, which had put Bolsonaro near 80% the day before the vote, and Bolsonaro said Sunday night that he does not recognize the outcome and will ask the courts to annul the election, extending political uncertainty beyond the market open.

The Ibovespa fell as much as 17% to about 170,000 points before the 10% drop trigger paused trading, and kept sliding after the 30-minute halt; for a dollar-based investor the currency and index moves combined to a loss of about 26% at their worst. Lula’s margin was about 4.4 million votes, according to Brazil’s Superior Electoral Court, while the latest Datafolha poll had the race tied at 50% each among valid votes.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
周日决选投票中，总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦以51.79%对48.21%击败参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，周一开盘巴西股市市值蒸发逾2000亿美元。iShares MSCI Brazil ETF（EWZ）从周五约42.60美元的收盘价最低跌至31.40美元，跌幅达26%；美元兑雷亚尔一度上涨12%；圣保罗交易所B3触发30分钟熔断，为新冠疫情以来首次。

这一结果与预测市场Polymarket和Kalshi的定价相悖——投票前一天两家平台给博索纳罗开出的胜率接近80%。博索纳罗周日晚表示不承认选举结果，将请求法院宣布选举无效，使政治不确定性在市场开盘之外继续延烧。

Ibovespa指数最低下跌17%至约170000点，跌幅触及10%后触发暂停交易，30分钟熔断结束后继续走低；对以美元计价的投资者而言，汇率与指数跌幅叠加，最差时合计损失约26%。据巴西最高选举法院，卢拉领先约440万票；而Datafolha最新民调显示，有效票中双方各为50%。
value.market_impact_en: The shock transmits to crypto mainly through emerging-market currency stress: a real that fell as much as 12% against the dollar raises local demand for dollar-denominated assets, a channel that in Brazil has historically fed stablecoin and offshore-crypto activity, while a 26% single-day drawdown in a major EM equity ETF pressures broader risk appetite. The event also puts a spotlight on crypto-linked prediction markets, since Polymarket priced the losing side at roughly 80%, a framing that may affect confidence and volumes in event contracts rather than any token’s fundamentals.
value.market_impact_zh: 这一冲击主要通过新兴市场货币压力传导至加密市场：雷亚尔兑美元一度下跌12%，会推高当地对美元计价资产的需求，这一渠道在巴西历来会带动稳定币与离岸加密活动；同时，主要新兴市场股票ETF单日26%的回撤也压制整体风险偏好。事件还把焦点投向与加密相关的预测市场——Polymarket给落败一方定价约80%，这可能影响事件合约的信心与成交，而非任何代币的基本面。

value.background: Trezor dropped CryptoBilis as an official reseller on October 9 following an $86 million Ledger wallet hack that relied on spyware installed in CryptoBilis-sold wallets; Ledger subsequently cut ties with official resellers across Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam and Hong Kong. At the time of the Ledger hack, Trezor said there was "not a single piece of evidence that Trezor devices have been compromised." Trezor says it is now reviewing its other Asia-based resellers.

At the time of the Ledger hack, Trezor said there was "not a single piece of evidence that Trezor devices have been compromised." Trezor says it is now reviewing its other Asia-based resellers.
value.background_zh: 在CryptoBilis售出的钱包中被植入间谍软件、并导致一起8600万美元Ledger钱包被盗事件后，Trezor于10月9日取消了CryptoBilis的官方经销商资格；Ledger随后切断了与马来西亚、印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南和香港官方经销商的合作。在Ledger事件发生时，Trezor曾表示“没有任何证据表明Trezor设备遭到入侵”。Trezor称目前正在审查其他亚洲经销商。
value.detailed_summary:
Trezor said a Safe 5 hardware wallet purchased from its official Malaysian reseller CryptoBilis in August contained a physical spyware implant — an extra circuit board fitted between the main board and the screen, carrying a cellular module and antenna. According to the user report, the implant reads what the screen displays, including wallet backups, and transmits it over a mobile network whenever the device is plugged in; Trezor has not yet examined the device in its lab but is treating the report as credible and will replace affected wallets.

Trezor's chief commercial officer Danny Sanders said, "We haven't had the device in our lab yet, but we're treating the report as credible, and we'd rather warn people now than wait for confirmation and find out someone lost their funds in the meantime." Buyers who purchased a wallet from CryptoBilis since March 2026 were told to move their funds out and contact Trezor for a replacement.

Trezor said it checked four other CryptoBilis-sourced Trezor wallets and "found no evidence of tampering," and it maintained that "no funds have been reported as stolen" in connection with this report. The described implant works similarly to the spyware previously found in Ledger devices.

Trezor表示，一台今年8月从其马来西亚官方经销商CryptoBilis处购买的Safe 5硬件钱包内被发现植入了实体间谍装置——在主board与屏幕之间加装了一块额外电路板，并带有蜂窝模块和天线。根据用户报告，该装置会读取屏幕显示的内容（包括钱包备份），并在设备插电时通过移动网络向外发送；Trezor尚未在实验室中检验该设备，但认为该报告可信，并将为受影响钱包提供更换。

Trezor首席商务官Danny Sanders表示：“我们还没有在实验室里拿到这台设备，但我们认为该报告可信，与其等到确认后再发现有人在此期间损失了资金，不如现在就发出警告。”Trezor告知自2026年3月起从CryptoBilis购买钱包的用户将资金转出，并联系Trezor团队获取替换钱包。

It affects self-custody holders of Trezor and competing hardware wallets through the custody-integrity channel rather than through price, and keeps supply-chain verification in focus for the sector.

value.background: The local smoothing conjecture was proposed by Christopher Sogge in 1991 and sits at the top of a chain of harmonic-analysis conjectures: it implies the Bochner–Riesz conjecture, which implies the restriction conjecture, which implies the Kakeya conjecture. The Exponential Time Hypothesis posits that 3-SAT cannot be solved in sub-exponential time and is widely used to derive hardness results, including in parameterized complexity. Yang–Mills existence and mass gap is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems set by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000.

The Exponential Time Hypothesis posits that 3-SAT cannot be solved in sub-exponential time and is widely used to derive hardness results, including in parameterized complexity. Yang–Mills existence and mass gap is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems set by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000.

value.detailed_summary:
OpenAI announced on October 26, 2026 that its models produced natural-language proofs of three long-standing open results: local smoothing for the Kakeya conjecture, the falsity of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), and the existence of quantum chromodynamics and completions of the Standard Model. The Yang–Mills existence proof was generated on September 9, 2026 and the QCD proof on September 18, 2026, with the release held back until Lean formalization of the Yang–Mills result was completed on October 16, 2026.

OpenAI framed the release around how researchers can verify and build on the results, and said the volume and complexity of the work was why publication waited on Lean formalization. Commenters with complexity-theory background treated an ETH refutation as the most consequential item, since ETH underpins many hardness and lower-bound results.

The local smoothing claim is presented as settling Kakeya and Stein's restriction conjecture in every dimension, a problem open since 1991. No independent verification of the proofs has been reported; coverage at the time of the announcement described the results as still unverified.

value.detailed_summary:
DeepSeek's second funding round has raised RMB105.5 billion (about $15.8 billion) from nearly 30 investors, according to The Information, citing two people with direct knowledge. Tencent and CATL remained the two largest investors, and state-owned investors contributed about 27% of this round, up from 2% in the first round.

The disclosure shows a sharp rise in state-linked participation between DeepSeek's two rounds, and the company doubled its fundraising target mid-way through a four-month process, which the report links to rising chip procurement costs and a desire to build a cash buffer.

Tencent put in RMB10 billion in each of the two rounds, while CATL and its chairman invested RMB5 billion in the first round and RMB10 billion in this one. Other participants included ChangXin Memory Technologies and its chairman Zhu Yiming, SMIC, vivo, Meituan, Geely, Midea, Luxshare Precision, Ctrip and Xiaohongshu at RMB1-3 billion each; China Mobile, China Telecom, CICC, CITIC Securities and China Life invested RMB2-8 billion each, and the National AI Development Fund contributed RMB1 billion again.

value.background: Blast announced on October 2 that it would gradually shut down the Layer 2 network, citing operating costs that exceeded revenue and the absence of a credible path to economic sustainability. Blast was an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack that offered built-in yield on deposited assets.
value.background_en: Blast announced on October 2 that it would gradually shut down the Layer 2 network, citing operating costs that exceeded revenue and the absence of a credible path to economic sustainability. Blast was an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack that offered built-in yield on deposited assets.
value.background_zh: Blast 于 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关闭该 Layer 2 网络，理由是运营成本超过收入，且缺乏实现经济可持续发展的可信路径。Blast 是基于 OP Stack 构建的以太坊 Layer 2，主打为存入资产提供内置收益。
value.detailed_summary:
Blast reached the deadline for its standard withdrawal interface on October 26, with roughly $40.41 million in assets still sitting in its official Ethereum mainnet bridge. That figure is down about 36% from approximately $63.5 million on October 2, when the Layer 2 network announced it would wind down.

After October 26, holders can still withdraw, but only by interacting directly with the bridge contracts on Ethereum rather than through the regular website interface, per Blast's prior notice.

Blast has published contract-level withdrawal guides for ETH, USDB and BLAST; the reported process involves initiating a withdrawal on Blast, waiting for the corresponding state record to be posted to Ethereum, submitting a withdrawal proof through the OptimismPortal contract, then a challenge period and a final confirmation transaction. At the time of the report, Blast's website still displayed a withdrawal entry point and notices about the network's gradual shutdown.

value.background: Exchange breaches have followed a recurring pattern in recent years, with attackers often targeting custody and key-management weaknesses and with post-incident disclosure becoming a focal point for users and researchers. Security analysts generally treat clear, timely incident communication as part of exchange risk management alongside cold storage and multi-signature controls.

value.detailed_summary:
A cryptocurrency exchange initially dismissed a security incident as a false alarm before later acknowledging that it had suffered a $16 million loss, according to Koin Bülteni. The exchange was not identified in the report, and no timeline or technical details of the incident were disclosed.

The reversal from denial to confirmed loss puts the focus on how exchanges communicate during incidents, since initial statements shape how users judge whether their funds are at risk.

The reported loss figure is $16 million. The report does not name the exchange or specify whether user funds, corporate funds or a hot wallet were affected.

value.background: Robinhood is a publicly traded US brokerage that has expanded beyond stock and options trading into crypto and prediction markets. Its crypto revenue has become a closely watched gauge of retail participation, and the stock was down 21.9% for the year ahead of this report.

value.detailed_summary:
Robinhood reported record revenue of $1.4 billion alongside a 14% drop in profit, with the results tied to losses in its own portfolio holdings. The online brokerage's shares came under pressure after the report, falling about 6.6% in pre-market trading from a $95 close on October 27 to $88.

The quarter shows Robinhood's top line expanding even as profitability weakens, and the stock reaction indicates investors are weighing the profit miss over the record revenue.

Crypto transaction revenue fell 55% year-over-year to $120 million in the third quarter ended September 30, though it still topped Street forecasts. Coverage of the results also pointed to declining interest income and rising expenses weighing on profit despite record trading activity in stocks, options and prediction markets.

value.background: Kintsu is a liquid staking protocol on the Monad blockchain whose staking yield token is used across DeFi integrations. StepDrainer is described by researchers as a malware-as-a-service drainer kit sold in underground markets, capable of draining wallets across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon and at least 17 other networks. Front-end attacks of this type typically rely on DNS cache poisoning, which injects false DNS records so visitors are served a fraudulent but convincing copy of a legitimate site.

StepDrainer is described by researchers as a malware-as-a-service drainer kit sold in underground markets, capable of draining wallets across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon and at least 17 other networks. Front-end attacks of this type typically rely on DNS cache poisoning, which injects false DNS records so visitors are served a fraudulent but convincing copy of a legitimate site.
value.background_zh: Kintsu 是 Monad 区块链上的流动性质押协议，其质押收益代币被用于各类 DeFi 集成场景。StepDrainer 被研究人员描述为在地下市场出售的"恶意软件即服务"式钱包窃取工具包，可从以太坊、BNB Chain、Arbitrum、Polygon 以及至少 17 条其他网络的钱包中转移资产。此类前端攻击通常借助 DNS 缓存投毒，通过注入虚假 DNS 记录，让访问者看到仿冒但高度逼真的合法网站副本。
value.detailed_summary:
Kintsu, a liquid staking protocol on the Monad blockchain, said on October 31 that its official website kintsu.xyz has been restored and again points to the project's own infrastructure. The team warned users to keep avoiding the site and not to connect wallets until DNS caches fully refresh and it issues an official security confirmation, noting that some networks may still reach the malicious site for up to an hour.

Security firm Blockaid, which flagged the ongoing front-end attack, advised users not to use the affected decentralized applications while it investigates. Kintsu's warning indicates the risk is not fully cleared even after the domain was restored, because DNS propagation delays can keep serving the malicious version.

According to Blockaid, malicious scripts were injected into the affected sites so that users who clicked "Connect Wallet" could be redirected to a page designed to move their assets. Blockaid said the attack was linked to the StepDrainer toolkit and involved three sites: kintsu, flap and stonkbrokers.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
基于 Monad 区块链的流动性质押协议 Kintsu 于 10 月 31 日表示，其官网 kintsu.xyz 已恢复正常并重新指向项目方自有基础设施。团队提醒用户，在 DNS 缓存完全刷新、官方发布安全确认之前，继续避免访问该网站并不要连接钱包，并称部分网络在未来一小时内仍可能访问到恶意网站。

最先披露此次正在进行的前端攻击的安全机构 Blockaid 建议用户暂时不要使用受影响的去中心化应用，并表示正在调查。Kintsu 的提醒说明，即便域名已恢复，风险也尚未完全解除，因为 DNS 传播延迟仍可能让部分用户访问到恶意版本。

据 Blockaid 称，受影响网站被植入恶意脚本，用户点击"Connect Wallet"（连接钱包）后可能被重定向至恶意的资产转移页面。Blockaid 表示该攻击与 StepDrainer 工具包有关，涉及 kintsu、flap 和 stonkbrokers 三个网站。

value.background: Initia is a Layer 1 blockchain built with the Cosmos SDK that aims to link a main network with a set of interwoven application rollups. Its native bridge is designed to move assets between Initia, its rollups and other blockchains, which made the bridge reserve a single point of dependency for users moving USDC. Bridge exploits have been a recurring attack vector across crypto, with on-chain trackers such as DefiLlama maintaining databases of such incidents.

value.background_zh: Initia 是一条基于 Cosmos SDK 构建的 Layer 1 区块链，目标是把主网与一组交织的应用 rollup 连接起来。其原生跨链桥用于在 Initia、各 rollup 与其他区块链之间转移资产，因此该桥的储备金成为用户转移 USDC 时的单点依赖。跨链桥攻击一直是加密行业的常见攻击面，DefiLlama 等链上数据平台专门收录此类事件。
value.detailed_summary:
Initia suffered a bridge exploit on October 23 that drained its USDC bridge reserve down to $63, with users unable to complete withdrawals. Reporting on the incident states roughly $3 million in real assets exited through bridges against $7 million in unbacked balances.

The reserve depletion left the bridge unable to honor user withdrawals, turning a protocol security breach into a direct loss of access for holders who relied on the bridge to move USDC on and off Initia.

The reported gap between the ~$3 million in real assets that left through bridges and the $7 million in unbacked balances indicates the shortfall exceeds the value actually withdrawn. The incident reduced the USDC bridge reserve to $63.

value.background: The NBA agreements come amid a legal battle over whether federal commodities rules supersede state gambling laws for sports prediction markets, producing conflicting court decisions. On Oct. 20 Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued Kalshi, seeking an estimated $30 million to $60 million in allegedly illegal profits, and 39 states plus Washington, DC have backed a petition asking the US Supreme Court to review the New Jersey dispute.

value.background_zh: NBA 的这些协议出台之际，围绕联邦大宗商品规则是否优先于州博彩法适用于体育预测市场，正存在一场法律争议，并已产生相互冲突的法院判决。9 月，美国第六巡回上诉法院在涉及俄亥俄州与田纳西州的案件中作出不利于 Kalshi 的裁决，此前第九巡回法院也有类似判决；而更早的第三巡回法院裁决则允许 Kalshi 在新泽西州上诉期间继续运营。10 月 20 日，犹他州总检察长 Derek Brown 起诉 Kalshi，寻求追回估计 3000 万至 6000 万美元的涉嫌非法获利；另有 39 个州及华盛顿特区支持一份请愿，要求美国最高法院复审新泽西州的争议。
value.detailed_summary:
The NBA announced Monday that Kalshi and Polymarket will become its preferred prediction-market platforms, able to settle NBA-related markets using official league data supplied by Sportradar, use NBA and team marks, and advertise during game broadcasts, while the league retains approval rights over which NBA markets they may list. The league also said it signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC, expanded its existing DraftKings deal to cover prediction markets, and expects similar arrangements with FanDuel and Fanatics in the coming weeks.

The deals give the two platforms official data, league branding and broadcast exposure tied to NBA markets, a level of endorsement a major North American league had not previously extended to prediction-market exchanges. The accompanying CFTC information-sharing agreement adds a regulatory-legitimacy channel alongside the industry's ongoing court fight over federal versus state oversight.

Under the integrity provisions, NBA players, team and league personnel are barred from trading NBA event contracts, and Kalshi and Polymarket must help the league identify suspicious trading, prevent insider trading and share data in investigations. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said the NBA agreement would strengthen information sharing on insider trading and fraud; the NBA joins Major League Baseball and the National Hockey League in establishing such arrangements with the regulator.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
NBA 周一宣布，Kalshi 与 Polymarket 将成为其首选预测市场平台，可使用由 Sportradar 提供的联盟官方数据结算 NBA 相关市场、使用 NBA 及球队标识，并在比赛转播中投放广告；同时 NBA 保留对两家平台可上线的 NBA 相关市场的审批权。联盟还表示已与美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）签署谅解备忘录，并将其与 DraftKings 的现有合作扩大至预测市场，预计未来数周与 FanDuel、Fanatics 达成类似安排。

这些协议让两家平台在 NBA 相关市场上获得官方数据、联盟品牌授权与转播曝光，这是北美主要职业体育联盟此前未给予预测市场交易所的背书程度。随附的 CFTC 信息共享协议，则在行业围绕联邦与州监管权限的诉讼持续之际，为预测市场增添了一条监管合法性渠道。

在诚信条款下，NBA 球员、球队及联盟工作人员不得交易 NBA 事件合约，Kalshi 与 Polymarket 须协助联盟识别可疑交易、防范内幕交易，并在调查中共享数据。CFTC 主席 Michael S. Selig 表示，与 NBA 的协议将加强针对内幕交易和欺诈的信息共享；NBA 由此加入美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）和北美职业冰球联盟（NHL）的行列，与该监管机构建立类似安排。
value.market_impact_en: The direct transmission runs through sports event contracts: official NBA data and league-approved markets give Kalshi and Polymarket a verifiable settlement and marketing edge in the highest-volume sports category, and Polymarket's crypto-based rails tie that potential volume growth to on-chain settlement venues. The CFTC MOU supports the regulatory-legitimacy side of the trade, but the unresolved state-versus-federal litigation remains a constraint on how far US sports market expansion can proceed.
value.market_impact_zh: 直接传导路径集中在体育事件合约上：官方 NBA 数据与联盟审批的市场，让 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 在交易量最大的体育品类中获得可验证的结算依据与营销优势；而 Polymarket 基于加密的结算轨道，将这部分潜在交易量增长与链上结算场所联系起来。CFTC 谅解备忘录则在监管合法性层面提供支撑，但尚未解决的州与联邦权限诉讼，仍限制着美国体育预测市场扩张的边界。

value.background_zh: 指数时间假说是关于布尔可满足性问题求解速度的一个尚未被证明的困难性假设，它与更广为人知的 P 与 NP 问题同属理论计算机科学的重大未解难题。归因于 OpenAI 的这一主张，延续了前沿实验室发布由 AI 生成的数学成果、而其正确性仍待研究者评估的模式。
value.detailed_summary:
TechCrunch published an interview with an MIT computer scientist about OpenAI's claim that its models produced a refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), an unproven hardness assumption in computational complexity theory. The piece is an explanatory interview about the claim rather than the underlying proof or an independent verification of it.

ETH underpins a large body of work on the hardness of satisfiability and on parameterized algorithms, so a valid refutation would unsettle results that assume it. New Scientist reported that, if confirmed, the result would force computer-science textbooks to be rewritten.

ETH, formulated by Impagliazzo and Paturi, states that satisfiability of 3-CNF Boolean formulas cannot be solved in subexponential time; its stronger variant, SETH, asserts that the limiting base-two exponent for k-SAT tends to one as clause width grows. Reports also note that OpenAI has posted a large batch of AI-generated math results of which only a portion has been machine-checked, and that mathematicians say few people understand them yet.

ETH 是大量关于可满足性问题困难性以及参数化算法研究的基础，因此若证伪成立，许多以该假说为前提的结论将受到动摇。《新科学家》报道称，若该结果得到确认，计算机科学教科书将不得不重写。

Neither channel implies a directional move, and the claim remains unverified.

value.detailed_summary:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu drew a public rebuke over a proposal to use cryptocurrency to bypass international economic sanctions. The Bank of Israel issued a rare criticism, saying cryptocurrencies cannot serve as a route around sanctions and that political leaders should focus on policy instead.

The pushback came from Israel's central bank, placing a sitting head of government at odds with his own monetary authority over a tool that sanctions enforcers already treat as a high-risk channel.

The rebuke was described as rare for the Bank of Israel, which argued that crypto cannot function as a sanctions workaround and urged a policy-focused approach instead.

value.background: DNS hijacking is an attack in which an attacker manipulates how domain-name queries are resolved — for example by tampering with DNS records, routers or DNS connections — so that users are redirected to malicious websites. Blockaid is a Web3 security platform that scans websites and dApps for threats before they reach users, and its detection feeds security features used by wallets and exchanges.
value.background_en: DNS hijacking is an attack in which an attacker manipulates how domain-name queries are resolved — for example by tampering with DNS records, routers or DNS connections — so that users are redirected to malicious websites. Blockaid is a Web3 security platform that scans websites and dApps for threats before they reach users, and its detection feeds security features used by wallets and exchanges.
value.background_zh: DNS 劫持是指攻击者通过篡改 DNS 记录、路由器或 DNS 连接等方式，操纵域名解析结果，从而把用户重定向到恶意网站的一类攻击。Blockaid 是一家 Web3 安全平台，通过扫描网站和 dApp 在威胁触达用户前进行识别，其检测能力被用于钱包和交易所的安全防护功能中。
value.detailed_summary:
Blockaid said in a post on X that it detected DNS hijacking attacks on the websites of several Web3 projects, including Flap and Stonk, so that visitors are redirected to hacker-controlled pages containing malware.

Anyone who reached these project front-ends through the hijacked domains could be routed to attacker infrastructure rather than the genuine site, exposing visitors to malware rather than interacting with the intended application.

The compromise described by Blockaid affects the DNS resolution of the projects' websites rather than their on-chain contracts, and Blockaid did not state in the post how many projects or how many users were affected.

The compromise described by Blockaid affects the DNS resolution of the projects' websites rather than their on-chain contracts, and Blockaid did not state in the post how many projects or how many users were affected.

通过被劫持的域名访问这些项目前端的用户，可能被导向攻击者控制的页面而非真实网站，从而面临恶意软件风险，而无法与原本的应用进行交互。

Blockaid 描述的这起事件影响的是项目网站的 DNS 解析环节，而非链上合约；该推文未说明受影响项目的具体数量或受影响用户规模。
value.market_impact_en: The channel here is front-end and user-facing trust rather than protocol liquidity: DNS-level compromises of dApp domains can push visitors toward phishing or drainer pages, so wallets and security tools that screen domains and dApp URLs are the segment most directly exposed.

value.background_zh: Jupiter Lend 是 Jupiter 在 Solana 上的借贷产品，提供面向追求收益的存款人的 Earn 金库，以及用户抵押资产借款的 Borrow 市场。在这类资金池中，存入的资产会被借出或投放，因此突然出现的集中提现可能超过即时可用流动性，从而形成排队。此次披露发生在 Binance 安全事件之后，该事件促使多家 Solana 借贷平台调整借款与提现条件。
value.detailed_summary:
Jupiter Lend said at 09:01 UTC on 30 October that a "liquidity crunch" was impacting withdrawals from the Solana-based lending protocol, leaving depositors waiting to get their funds out. The protocol stated it has zero exposure to Binance and suffered no losses from the recent Binance security incident.

The disruption directly impairs depositors' ability to exit a major Solana lending venue, and it came within hours of another Solana lender, Kamino, pausing SOL/BTC borrowing after the Binance incident.

Kamino paused SOL/BTC borrowing within hours of the Binance hack, according to Solana Compass. DIA Data lists Jupiter Lend at roughly $2.0 billion in total value locked across 23 pools on one chain and notes the protocol has not published audit reports.

这一中断直接影响了存款人从 Solana 主要借贷平台退出的能力，且发生的时间点恰在另一家 Solana 借贷协议 Kamino 因 Binance 事件暂停 SOL/BTC 借款后的数小时之内。

value.current_state_en: Anthropic filed its S-1 with the SEC on October 26, 2026, formally starting its Nasdaq IPO registration under ticker ANT; the filing discloses H1 2026 revenue of $16.3B, a net loss of $80.7B, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as leads, and a warning that it may not achieve or maintain profitability. The S-1 also discloses that Anthropic may issue up to $42B in convertible promissory notes, says existing cash and cash equivalents are sufficient for at least the next 12 months of working capital and other needs, and expects compute and infrastructure expenses to keep increasing and become its largest operating expense. In addition to up to $120.5B in SpaceX AI-related spending commitments through 2029, the S-1 discloses expected payments to Google of up to about $114.5B by 2033 and about $161.2B in Broadcom lease rent (excluding interest), warns that additional financing may be needed sooner, and says pretraining of its next frontier model was delayed more than a month to strengthen safety. The latest disclosures also show that 79% of revenue comes from outside its top five customers, no single customer contributes more than 10% of total revenue, and the company acknowledges it previously significantly underestimated compute demand; Amazon will provide up to $20B in financing under an April agreement, Google has purchased 38.6 million G-2 non-voting redeemable shares, and Anthropic says it has not reached any agreement for a material acquisition.

value.current_state_en: The Binance ~$6.3B hack remains under investigation; multiple breach points have been confirmed, about $3B in assets has been frozen, and losses will be covered by the company. Binance has reserved over $6.34B in company funds to cover losses, including $5B in affected tokens, is buying the remainder through market and OTC channels, and will verify user assets via Proof of Reserves. Binance is working with the FBI and other law enforcement to recover frozen and stolen assets. Analysts attribute the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor. New onchain analysis shows attacker-linked addresses holding 18,270 BTC and 508,621 ETH. Security firm Blockaid indicated that compromised signing systems were the root cause, and EIP-7702 may have amplified losses but was not necessary.

value.what_changed_en: Ethereum Foundation researcher Toni Wahrstätter further detailed ChainSecurity's EIP-8037 audit findings: contracts with hardcoded gas forwarding are affected by state-write repricing; EIP-8037 breaks invariants some coding patterns rely on, allowing consumed gas to be refunded mid-transaction, which can raise gasleft(), cause gas-counter underflow and rollback, let failed subcalls return gas and execute otherwise-unreachable paths, and make GAS-opcode measurements underestimate usage. He said the Hoodi delay bought time but did not solve the issue, that spec changes may ultimately be needed, and called on app developers and auditors to check and report EIP-8037/EIP-8038-related issues.
value.what_changed_zh: 以太坊基金会研究员 Toni Wahrstätter 进一步说明 ChainSecurity 对 EIP-8037 的审计发现：硬编码转发 Gas 的合约受状态写入成本上升影响，且 EIP-8037 打破部分编码模式依赖的不变量，已消耗 Gas 可在交易中途返还，导致 gasleft() 上升、Gas 计数器下溢回滚、失败子调用返还 Gas 使不应执行路径被执行，以及 GAS 操作码低估用量；他称 Hoodi 推迟仅争取时间，问题未解决，最坏情况需修改规范，并呼吁应用开发者和审计方排查 EIP-8037/EIP-8038 相关问题。
